Готово. Все 16 тестов проходят, оба пакета анализируются без ошибок.

## Что сделано

### 1) Типы ошибок и их использование в usecase

**`ExportErrorType`** ([export_usecase.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/domain/usecase/export_usecase.dart)): `noNotes`, `encryptionFailed`, `fileWriteFailed`, `unknown`.

**`ImportErrorType`** ([import_usecase.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/domain/usecase/import_usecase.dart)): `invalidFile`, `wrongPassword`, `notAuthenticated`, `unknown`.

**[export_usecase_impl.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/data/export_usecase_impl.dart)** — обёрнуты этапы:
- шифрование → `ExportError(encryptionFailed)`;
- запись/zip файла (включая пустой zip) → `ExportError(fileWriteFailed)`;
- всё остальное → `ExportError(unknown)` (через `on ExportError { rethrow; }`).
- Пустое хранилище по-прежнему возвращает `''` (контракт сохранён, тест не сломан) — `noNotes` поднимается на уровне блока.

**[import_usecase_impl.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/data/import_usecase_impl.dart)**:
- `_readFile` теперь бросает `ImportError(invalidFile)` (нет файла / не zip / нет json / неверная версия / повреждение) и возвращает non-null;
- нет приватного ключа → `ImportError(notAuthenticated)`;
- деривация ключа + расшифровка → `ImportError(wrongPassword)`;
- этап записи в стор/outbox → `ImportError(unknown)`.

### 2) Обработка в экране + локализация

- [export_import_screen.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/presentation/settings/export_import/export_import_screen.dart): `messageBuilder` через `_errorMessage(...)` маппит `ExportError`/`ImportError` по `payload` в локализованные строки; для `unknown` возвращает `null` → `showError` подставляет дефолтное «Something went wrong».
- Блок ([export_import_bloc.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/presentation/settings/export_import/bloc/export_import_bloc.dart)) при пустом пути отдаёт `ExportError(noNotes)` вместо тихого idle.

```text
12	
13	/// Resolves a per-note import collision: when a backup note shares its d-tag
14	/// (`kind:pubkey:d-tag` coordinate) with an already stored note, the policy
15	/// produces the single resulting note for that d-tag.
16	///
17	/// The result always keeps the original d-tag, so the event store replaces the
18	/// stored version natively via addressable-event (NIP-33) semantics — no relay
19	/// deletion is involved. When there is no collision ([existing] is `null`)
20	/// every policy returns the incoming note unchanged.
21	sealed class ImportPolicy {
22	  const ImportPolicy();
23	
24	  /// Combine both notes: keep the existing content and append the imported one
25	  /// (labels from both are merged).
26	  const factory ImportPolicy.mergeContent() = MergeContent;
27	
28	  /// On collision the imported note wins (overwrites the stored one).
29	  const factory ImportPolicy.keepIncoming() = KeepIncoming;
30	
31	  /// On collision the stored note wins (the imported one is dropped).
32	  const factory ImportPolicy.keepExisting() = KeepExisting;
33	
34	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing);
35	}
36	
37	final class MergeContent extends ImportPolicy {
38	  const MergeContent();
39	
40	  static const separator = '\n\n------ Imported ------\n\n';
41	
42	  @override
43	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing) {
44	    if (existing == null) {
45	      return incoming;
46	    }
47	    return incoming.copyWith(
48	      content: '${existing.content}$separator${incoming.content}',
49	      labels: {...existing.labels, ...incoming.labels}.toList(),
50	    );
51	  }
52	}
53	
54	final class KeepIncoming extends ImportPolicy {
55	  const KeepIncoming();
56	
57	  @override
58	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing) => incoming;
59	}
60	
61	final class KeepExisting extends ImportPolicy {
62	  const KeepExisting();
63	
64	  @override
65	  Note apply(Note incoming, Note? existing) => existing ?? incoming;
66	}
67	
68	final class ImportError extends CustomError<ImportErrorType> {
69	  const ImportError({required super.payload, super.parentError, super.reason});
70	}
71	
72	enum ImportErrorType {
73	  /// The file is missing, not a valid archive, or has an unsupported version.
74	  invalidFile,
75	
76	  /// Decryption failed — wrong password or the backup is corrupted.
77	  wrongPassword,
78	
79	  /// No unlocked session is available to re-encrypt the imported notes.
80	  notAuthenticated,
```

---

## Solution

`file_picker ^12.0.0-0` (pinned to `12.0.0-beta.5`) is the answer to all three problems simultaneously:

| Problem | 3.0.4 | 10.x | **12.0.0-beta.5** |
|---|---|---|---|
| win32 conflict with share_plus 13 | ✅ (no win32 dep at all) | ❌ win32 ^5.9.0 | ✅ win32 ^6.2.0 |
| iOS Swift Package Manager | ❌ CocoaPods-only | ❌ CocoaPods-only | ✅ `sharedDarwinSource: true` |
| Flutter 3.44.0 compatible | ⚠️ very old | ✅ | ✅ requires ≥3.38.0 |

**Why 12.x works**: The `<12.0.0-beta.1` boundary in the resolver message is exactly where the author switched from `win32 ^5.9.0` to `^6.2.0` and rewrote the iOS/macOS native layer as a `darwin/` shared SPM package instead of separate CocoaPods podspecs. After `pub get`, Flutter confirms: **"All plugins found for ios are Swift Packages"**.

**One caveat**: the constraint `^12.0.0-0` permits pre-release versions. Once 12.x goes stable you can tighten it to `^12.0.0`.

```text
# Flutter File Picker Setup Requirements

## Android
- Runtime permissions are included with the plugin
- Ensure compatible Gradle versions for Android 11+ compatibility
- The `<query>` tag must be recognized by Gradle
- If overriding `onActivityResult` in MainActivity, call `super.onActivityResult(...)` for unhandled activities to prevent silent failures

## iOS
- Minimum deployment target: iOS 14.0
- Update deployment target in Podfile and Xcode project settings

**Info.plist Configuration** (add to `<project root>/ios/Runner/Info.plist`):

| FileType | Key | Purpose |
|----------|-----|---------|
| `.any` or `.custom` | `UIBackgroundModes` | Add `fetch` and `remote-notification` keys for background task access |
| `.audio` | `NSAppleMusicUsageDescription` | Provide permission rationale for music library access |
| `.image` or `.video` | `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` | Provide permission rationale for photo library access |
| Directory writing | `UISupportsDocumentBrowser` | Set to `true` for directory write support |
| `.all` file type | `LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace` | Set to `true` to open original files instead of caching |

## Web
- Requires "Flutter 2.0 or above"

## macOS
- Enable desktop platform: `flutter config --enable-macos-desktop`
- Add entitlements to both `macos/Runner/DebugProfile.entitlements` and `macos/Runner/Release.entitlements`
- **Read-only access**: `com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-only` = `true`
- **Read/write access**: `com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-write` = `true`
- Supports CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager (SPM)

## Desktop (Linux, Windows)
- Enable platforms via:
  - `flutter config --enable-windows-desktop`
  - `flutter config --enable-linux-desktop`
- Implementation is entirely in Dart (v4.0.0+)
```

1. Pop all settings screens in the inner navigator (the `DrawerRouter`'s own `Navigator`)
2. Close the drawer (end drawer in this case based on the `OnEndDrawer` class)

The `DrawerRouter` has its own `Navigator` which hosts the settings screens. The outer context would have the `Scaffold` with the end drawer.

- Close the end drawer using the `Scaffold` context

The challenge is that we have nested navigators — the `DrawerRouter`'s inner `Navigator` and the outer one — and the `context` in the `onRoute` callback is inside the `RouteHandlerWidget`, which is a child of the `DrawerRouter`'s `Navigator`. To close the drawer, I need to reach up to the `Scaffold` context that's outside the `DrawerRouter`.

Since the `DrawerRouter`'s `Navigator` is placed inside the end drawer, the context passed to `onRoute` should be a descendant of the `Scaffold`, so `Scaffold.maybeOf(context)?.closeEndDrawer()` might work if the context can find the `Scaffold` ancestor. But I need to verify what context is actually being passed in the `onRoute` callback to make sure it has the right scope. Finishing the route handler... So the key is the order of operations: I need to pop back to the initial SettingsScreen first, then close the drawer. If I close the drawer without popping, the navigation stack stays in whatever state it was, so reopening the drawer would show the last settings screen the user was viewing. Popping first ensures we return to a clean state before dismissing the drawer.

```text
import 'dart:typed_data';

mixin HexToBytes {
  static Uint8List hexToBytes(String src) {
    return src.hexToBytes();
  }

  static String bytesToHex(Uint8List bytes) =>
      bytes.map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
}

extension on String {
  Uint8List hexToBytes() {
    final theLength = length;
    final result = Uint8List(theLength ~/ 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < theLength; i += 2) {
      result[i ~/ 2] = int.parse(substring(i, i + 2), radix: 16);
    }
    return result;
  }
}
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'package:collection/collection.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart' as crypto;
import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/auth/domain/model/nip44_exception.dart';

final class Nip44Utils {
  const Nip44Utils();
  Uint8List secureRandomBytes(int length) {
    final random = Random.secure();
    return Uint8List.fromList(
      List<int>.generate(length, (_) => random.nextInt(256)),
    );
  }

  Map<String, Uint8List> deriveMessageKeys(
    Uint8List conversationKey,
    Uint8List nonce,
  ) {
    if (conversationKey.length != 32) {
      throw const InvalidConversationKeyLengthNip44Exception();
    }
    if (nonce.length != 32) {
      throw const InvalidNonceLengthNip44Exception();
    }

    final hkdfOutput = hkdfExpand(
      prk: conversationKey,
      info: nonce,
      length: 76,
    );

    return {
      'chachaKey': hkdfOutput.sublist(0, 32),
      'chachaNonce': hkdfOutput.sublist(32, 44), // Should be 12 bytes
      'hmacKey': hkdfOutput.sublist(44, 76),
    };
  }

  Uint8List pad(Uint8List plaintext) {
    int unpaddedLen = plaintext.length;
    if (unpaddedLen < 1 || unpaddedLen > 65535) {
      throw const InvalidPlaintextLengthNip44Exception();
    }

    int paddedLen = calcPaddedLen(unpaddedLen);
    Uint8List padded = Uint8List(paddedLen + 2);

    // First two bytes are the length in big-endian
    padded[0] = (unpaddedLen >> 8) & 0xFF;
    padded[1] = unpaddedLen & 0xFF;

    padded.setRange(2, 2 + unpaddedLen, plaintext);

    // The rest is zeros by default
    return padded;
  }

  int calcPaddedLen(int unpaddedLen) {
    int nextPower = 1 << ((unpaddedLen - 1).bitLength);
    int chunk = nextPower <= 256 ? 32 : nextPower ~/ 8;
    if (unpaddedLen <= 32) {
      return 32;
    } else {
      return chunk * ((unpaddedLen - 1) ~/ chunk + 1);
    }
  }

  Future<Uint8List> encryptChaCha20(
    Uint8List key,
    Uint8List nonce,
    Uint8List data,
  ) async {
    final algorithm = Chacha20(macAlgorithm: MacAlgorithm.empty);
    final skey = SecretKey(key);
    final secretBox = await algorithm.encrypt(
      data,
      secretKey: skey,
      nonce: nonce,
    );

    return Uint8List.fromList(secretBox.cipherText);
  }

  Future<Uint8List> decryptChaCha20(
    Uint8List key,
    Uint8List nonce,
    Uint8List ciphertext,
  ) async {
    final algorithm = Chacha20(macAlgorithm: MacAlgorithm.empty);
    final skey = SecretKey(key);
    final secretBox = SecretBox(ciphertext, nonce: nonce, mac: Mac.empty);

    final plaintext = await algorithm.decrypt(secretBox, secretKey: skey);

    return Uint8List.fromList(plaintext);
  }

  String constructPayload(
    Uint8List nonce,
    Uint8List ciphertext,
    Uint8List mac,
  ) {
    Uint8List payloadBytes = Uint8List.fromList([
      0x02, // Version
      ...nonce,
      ...ciphertext,
      ...mac,
    ]);
    return base64.encode(payloadBytes);
  }

  Uint8List hkdfExtract({required Uint8List ikm, required Uint8List salt}) {
    var hmacSha256 = crypto.Hmac(crypto.sha256, salt);
    var prk = hmacSha256.convert(ikm).bytes;
    return Uint8List.fromList(prk);
  }

  Uint8List hkdfExpand({
    required Uint8List prk,
    required Uint8List info,
    required int length,
  }) {
    var hashLen = 32;
    int n = (length + hashLen - 1) ~/ hashLen;
    var okm = <int>[];
    var previous = <int>[];

    for (var i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
      var hmacSha256 = crypto.Hmac(crypto.sha256, prk);
      var data = <int>[...previous, ...info, i];
      previous = hmacSha256.convert(data).bytes;
      okm.addAll(previous);
    }
    return Uint8List.fromList(okm.sublist(0, length));
  }

  Uint8List unpad(Uint8List padded) {
    int unpaddedLen = (padded[0] << 8) + padded[1];
    if (unpaddedLen == 0 || unpaddedLen > padded.length - 2) {
      throw const InvalidPaddingNip44Exception();
    }
    return padded.sublist(2, 2 + unpaddedLen);
  }

  Uint8List calculateMac(Uint8List key, Uint8List nonce, Uint8List ciphertext) {
    var hmacSha256 = crypto.Hmac(crypto.sha256, key);
    var mac = hmacSha256.convert([...nonce, ...ciphertext]).bytes;
    return Uint8List.fromList(mac);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> parsePayload(String payload) {
    if (payload.isEmpty || payload[0] == '#') {
      throw const UnknownVersionNip44Exception();
    }

    if (payload.length < 132 || payload.length > 87472) {
      throw const InvalidPayloadSizeNip44Exception();
    }

    late final Uint8List data;
    try {
      data = base64.decode(payload);
    } on FormatException {
      throw const InvalidPayloadEncodingNip44Exception();
    }

    if (data[0] != 0x02) {
      throw const UnsupportedVersionNip44Exception();
    }

    Uint8List nonce = data.sublist(1, 33);
    Uint8List mac = data.sublist(data.length - 32);
    Uint8List ciphertext = data.sublist(33, data.length - 32);

    return {'nonce': nonce, 'ciphertext': ciphertext, 'mac': mac};
  }

  void verifyMac(
    Uint8List hmacKey,
    Uint8List nonce,
    Uint8List ciphertext,
    Uint8List mac,
  ) {
    Uint8List calculatedMac = calculateMac(hmacKey, nonce, ciphertext);
    if (!const ListEquality().equals(calculatedMac, mac)) {
      throw const InvalidMacNip44Exception();
    }
  }

  String checkPublicKey(String publicKey) {
    if (publicKey.length == 66 &&
        (publicKey.startsWith('02') || publicKey.startsWith('03'))) {
      return publicKey;
    } else if (publicKey.length > 66 && publicKey.startsWith('04')) {
      return publicKey;
    } else if (publicKey.length == 64) {
      return '02$publicKey';
    }
    throw const InvalidPublicKeyNip44Exception();
  }
}
```

```text
import 'package:elliptic/ecdh.dart';

import 'package:nostr_notes/services/nip44/nip_44_utils.dart';

final class DeriveKeys with HexToBytes {
  const DeriveKeys();

  Uint8List execute({
    required String senderPrivateKey,
    required String recipientPublicKey,
    Uint8List Function(Uint8List)? extraDerivation,
  }) {
    final key = spec256k1(senderPrivateKey, recipientPublicKey);

    if (extraDerivation == null) {
      return key;
    }

    final resut = extraDerivation(key);

    return resut;
  }

  Uint8List spec256k1FromBytes({
    required Uint8List privateKeyBytes,
    required Uint8List publicKeyBytes,
  }) {
    return _spec256k1FromBytes(
      privateKeyBytes: privateKeyBytes,
      publicKeyBytes: publicKeyBytes,
    );
  }

  static Uint8List spec256k1(String privateKeyHex, String publicKeyHex) {
    final ec = getS256();
    final privateKey = PrivateKey.fromHex(ec, privateKeyHex);
    final publicKey = PublicKey.fromHex(
      ec,
      const Nip44Utils().checkPublicKey(publicKeyHex),
    );
    final sec = computeSecret(privateKey, publicKey);
    return Uint8List.fromList(sec);
  }

  static Uint8List _spec256k1FromBytes({
    required Uint8List privateKeyBytes,
    required Uint8List publicKeyBytes,
  }) {
    final ec = getS256();
    final privateKey = PrivateKey.fromBytes(ec, privateKeyBytes);
    final publicKey = PublicKey.fromHex(
      ec,
      const Nip44Utils().checkPublicKey(HexToBytes.bytesToHex(publicKeyBytes)),
    );
    final sec = computeSecret(privateKey, publicKey);
    return Uint8List.fromList(sec);
  }
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-09 12:46:31Z)**_

Now I have the full picture.

---

## `elliptic` → `cryptography`: Not possible

`cryptography` only has NIST curves (P-256/P-384/P-521) and X25519. `elliptic` is used for **secp256k1 ECDH** (`getS256()` + `computeSecret()`) in `derive_keys.dart` — the Nostr/Bitcoin curve. There is no secp256k1 in `cryptography`. `elliptic` stays.

---

## `crypto` → `cryptography`: Not worth it

Three call sites, three problems:

| File | Usage | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| `note_crypto_use_case.dart:255` | `sha256.convert(pin)` — sync | `cryptography`'s `Sha256().hash()` returns `Future<Hash>` — requires making the caller async |
| `nip_44_utils.dart` | `crypto.Hmac(crypto.sha256, ...)` in `hkdfExtract`, `hkdfExpand`, `calculateMac` — all sync, called in a loop | Same async cascade — `deriveMessageKeys` would become async, which ripples into `nip44.dart` and its callers |
| `classification_datasource.dart:218` | `crypto.md5.convert(bytes)` | **`cryptography` has no MD5** — it's a security-focused library that deliberately omits broken hashes |

The MD5 point alone settles it: you can't drop `crypto` even if you ported SHA-256 and HMAC. And for those two, `crypto` is actually the **better fit** — it's the Dart team's package designed exactly for synchronous hash/HMAC over byte arrays, which is exactly what all three call sites need.

**Keep both. They're doing different jobs:**
- `crypto` — sync SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256 (HKDF), MD5
- `cryptography` — async AES-CBC (backup), PBKDF2 (key derivation), ChaCha20 (NIP-44 encrypt/decrypt)

```text
163	  /// Loads and decrypts the stored notes whose d-tag matches any incoming one,

165	  Future<Map<String, Note>> _loadExistingByDTag(
166	    List<Note> incoming,
167	    String pubkey,
168	  ) async {
169	    final dTags = incoming
170	        .map((n) => n.dTag)
171	        .where((d) => d.isNotEmpty)
172	        .toList();
173	    if (dTags.isEmpty) {

175	    }

177	    final events = await _eventStore.queryEvents(

194	  /// The summary is derived from content, so it must be regenerated whenever a
195	  /// policy rewrote the content (MergeContent). keepIncoming/keepExisting leave
196	  /// content untouched and thus keep their already-correct summary.
197	  Note _withFreshSummary(Note resolved, Note incoming, Note? existing) {
198	    final contentChanged =
199	        resolved.content != incoming.content &&
200	        resolved.content != existing?.content;
201	    if (!contentChanged) {
202	      return resolved;
203	    }
204	    return resolved.copyWith(summary: CrerateSummaryHelper.create(resolved));

207	  FutureOr<_AlgData?> _prepareAlgDataIfNeeded(
208	    BackupPayload payload,
209	    String password,
210	  ) async {
211	    if (!payload.encrypted) {
212	      return null;
213	    }
214	
215	    final salt = HexToBytes.hexToBytes(payload.salt!);
216	    final iterations = payload.iterations ?? _kPbkdf2Iterations;
217	    final secretKey = await ExportHelper.deriveKey(password, salt, iterations);
218	    final algorithm = AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256());
219	    return _AlgData(secretKey, algorithm);
220	  }

222	  /// Re-encrypts [note] under the current account and produces a properly
223	  /// signed event (correct id + sig), reusing the note's d-tag.
224	  ///
225	  /// Date handling follows the Nostr/app conventions:
226	  /// - `created_at` is the publication timestamp and is refreshed to `now` on
227	  ///   every (re)publish — it feeds the event id/sig, and the store resolves
228	  ///   replaceable-event conflicts by it, so the result always supersedes the
229	  ///   stored version sharing the d-tag.
230	  /// - `init_at` (the `updated_at` tag) is carried over unchanged; an import is
231	  ///   not a user content edit.
232	  Future<NostrEvent> _buildSignedEvent({
233	    required Note note,
234	    required String pubkey,
235	    required String privateKey,
236	  }) async {
237	    final createdAt = _now.now();
238	
239	    // Refresh created_at; keep the original init_at (note.updatedAt).
240	    final preparedNote = note.copyWith(createdAt: createdAt);
241	
242	    final reEncrypted = await _noteCryptoUseCase.encryptNote(preparedNote);
243	    final tags = NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(reEncrypted, pubkey: pubkey).tags;
244	
245	    return _eventCreator.createEvent(
246	      kind: EventKind.note.value,
247	      content: reEncrypted.content,
248	      createdAt: createdAt,
249	      tags: tags,
250	      pubkey: pubkey,
251	      privateKey: privateKey,
252	    );
253	  }

255	  FutureOr<String> _decryptFieldIfNeeded(String encoded, _AlgData? algData) {
256	    return algData == null ? encoded : _decryptField(encoded, algData);
257	  }
258	
259	  Future<String> _decryptField(String encoded, _AlgData algData) async {
260	    if (encoded.isEmpty) return '';
261	    final parts = encoded.split('?iv=');
262	    final cipherText = base64Decode(parts[0]);
263	    final ivAndMac = parts[1].split('&mac=');
264	    final iv = base64Decode(ivAndMac[0]);
265	    final mac = Mac(base64Decode(ivAndMac[1]));
266	    final plainBytes = await algData.algorithm.decrypt(
267	      SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
268	      secretKey: algData.secretKey,
269	    );
270	    return utf8.decode(plainBytes);
271	  }
272	
273	  FutureOr<List<BaseLabel>> _decryptLabelsIfNeeded(
274	    List<BaseLabel> labels,
275	    _AlgData? algData,
276	  ) {
277	    return algData == null ? labels : _decryptLabels(labels, algData);
278	  }
279	
280	  Future<List<BaseLabel>> _decryptLabels(
281	    List<BaseLabel> labels,
282	    _AlgData algData,
283	  ) async {
284	    if (labels.isEmpty) return const [];
285	    final decrypted = await _decryptField(labels.first.textValue, algData);
286	    if (decrypted.isEmpty) return const [];
287	    return BaseLabel.fromJoinedText(decrypted);
288	  }
289	}
```

The linter wants `const` on `SuccessState` constructor, but `Uint8List` isn't const-compatible. However, as we've discussed before in Dart, a `const` constructor can have `Uint8List?` or `Uint8List` fields - the constructor itself can be `const` even if you can't actually call it with `const` when passing a non-const `Uint8List`. The field itself defaults... wait, `bytes` is required and `Uint8List` can't be a compile-time constant.

Actually, in Dart, a `const` constructor just means "this constructor CAN be used to create a compile-time constant when all arguments are compile-time constants." The type of the field itself doesn't prevent the constructor from being declared `const`.
So the declaration is valid - you just won't be able to use `const` when instantiating it with an actual `Uint8List`, but the linter still wants the constructor marked `const`.

```text
758	BackupPayload _readExportJson(String zipFilePath) {
759	  final archive = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(File(zipFilePath).readAsBytesSync());
760	  final jsonBytes =
761	      archive.findFile(ExportUsecaseImpl.archivedFileName)!.content
762	          as List<int>;
763	  return BackupPayload.fromJson(

765	  );
766	}

768	String _findTag(List<dynamic> tags, String name) {
769	  final tag =
770	      tags.firstWhere((t) => (t as List<dynamic>).first == name)
771	          as List<dynamic>;
772	  return tag[1] as String;
773	}

775	Future<String> _decryptExportField(
776	  String encoded, {
777	  required String password,
778	  required Uint8List salt,
779	}) async {
780	  final parts = encoded.split('?iv=');
781	  final cipherText = base64Decode(parts[0]);
782	  final ivAndMac = parts[1].split('&mac=');
783	  final iv = base64Decode(ivAndMac[0]);
784	  final mac = Mac(base64Decode(ivAndMac[1]));
785	
786	  final secretKey = await Pbkdf2(
787	    macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
788	    iterations: 600000,
789	    bits: 256,
790	  ).deriveKeyFromPassword(password: password, nonce: salt);
791	
792	  final plainBytes = await AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256())
793	      .decrypt(
794	        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
795	        secretKey: secretKey,
796	      );
797	
798	  return utf8.decode(plainBytes);
799	}
```

```dart
// ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _seedEncryptedNote({
  required RawEventStore eventStore,
  required NoteCryptoUseCase noteCryptoUseCase,
  required Note note,
}) async {
  final encrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.encryptNote(note);
  await eventStore.upsert([
    NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(encrypted, pubkey: NotesFixtures.keys.publicKey),
  ]);
}

Future<void> _clearNotes(RawEventStore eventStore) async {
  final events = await eventStore.queryEvents(
    RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
  );
  if (events.isNotEmpty) {
    await eventStore.deleteEvents(events.map((e) => e.id).toSet());
  }
}

BackupPayload _readExportJson(String zipFilePath) {
  final archive = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(File(zipFilePath).readAsBytesSync());
  final jsonBytes =
      archive.findFile(ExportUsecaseImpl.archivedFileName)!.content
          as List<int>;
  return BackupPayload.fromJson(
    jsonDecode(utf8.decode(jsonBytes)) as Map<String, dynamic>,
  );
}

String _findTag(List<dynamic> tags, String name) {
  final tag =
      tags.firstWhere((t) => (t as List<dynamic>).first == name)
          as List<dynamic>;
  return tag[1] as String;
}

Future<String> _decryptExportField(
  String encoded, {
  required String password,
  required Uint8List salt,
}) async {
  final parts = encoded.split('?iv=');
  final cipherText = base64Decode(parts[0]);
  final ivAndMac = parts[1].split('&mac=');
  final iv = base64Decode(ivAndMac[0]);
  final mac = Mac(base64Decode(ivAndMac[1]));

  final secretKey = await Pbkdf2(
    macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
    iterations: 600000,
    bits: 256,
  ).deriveKeyFromPassword(password: password, nonce: salt);

  final plainBytes = await AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256())
      .decrypt(
        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
        secretKey: secretKey,
      );

  return utf8.decode(plainBytes);
}
```

```text
754	// ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
755	
756	Future<void> _seedEncryptedNote({
757	  required RawEventStore eventStore,
758	  required NoteCryptoUseCase noteCryptoUseCase,
759	  required Note note,
760	}) async {
761	  final encrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.encryptNote(note);
762	  await eventStore.upsert([
763	    NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(encrypted, pubkey: NotesFixtures.keys.publicKey),
764	  ]);
765	}
766	
767	Future<void> _clearNotes(RawEventStore eventStore) async {
768	  final events = await eventStore.queryEvents(
769	    RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
770	  );
771	  if (events.isNotEmpty) {
772	    await eventStore.deleteEvents(events.map((e) => e.id).toSet());
773	  }
774	}
775	
776	BackupPayload _readExportJson(String zipFilePath) {
777	  final archive = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(File(zipFilePath).readAsBytesSync());
778	  final jsonBytes =
779	      archive.findFile(ExportUsecaseImpl.archivedFileName)!.content
780	          as List<int>;
781	  return BackupPayload.fromJson(
782	    jsonDecode(utf8.decode(jsonBytes)) as Map<String, dynamic>,
783	  );
784	}
785	
786	String _findTag(List<dynamic> tags, String name) {
787	  final tag =
788	      tags.firstWhere((t) => (t as List<dynamic>).first == name)
789	          as List<dynamic>;
790	  return tag[1] as String;
791	}
792	
793	Future<String> _decryptExportField(
794	  String encoded, {
795	  required String password,
796	  required Uint8List salt,
797	}) async {
798	  final parts = encoded.split('?iv=');
799	  final cipherText = base64Decode(parts[0]);
800	  final ivAndMac = parts[1].split('&mac=');
801	  final iv = base64Decode(ivAndMac[0]);
802	  final mac = Mac(base64Decode(ivAndMac[1]));
803	
804	  final secretKey = await Pbkdf2(
805	    macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
806	    iterations: 600000,
807	    bits: 256,
808	  ).deriveKeyFromPassword(password: password, nonce: salt);
809	
810	  final plainBytes = await AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256())
811	      .decrypt(
812	        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
813	        secretKey: secretKey,
814	      );
815	
816	  return utf8.decode(plainBytes);
817	}
```

```dart
import '../../tools/mock_wschannel.dart';
import '../../tools/mocks/mock_relays_list_repo.dart';
import '../../tools/some_moked_data.dart';
import 'fixtures/notes_fixtures.dart';

class _MockChannelFactory extends Mock implements ChannelFactory {}

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  setUpAll(() {
    TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger
        .setMockMethodCallHandler(
          const MethodChannel('plugins.flutter.io/path_provider'),
          (call) async {
            if (call.method == 'getTemporaryDirectory') {
              return Directory.systemTemp.path;
            }
            return null;
          },
        );
  });

  const password = 'test_p@ssword_123';

  group('ExportUsecaseImpl + ImportUsecaseImpl', () {
    late RawEventStore eventStore;
    late OutboxDaoInterface outboxDao;
    late NoteCryptoUseCase noteCryptoUseCase;
    late SessionUsecase sessionUsecase;
    late ExportUsecaseImpl exportSut;
    late ImportUsecaseImpl importSut;

    setUp(() async {
      final di = DiStorage.shared;
      di.bind<ErrorMessagesProvider>(
        () => const MockErrorMessagesProvider(),
        module: null,
        lifeTime: const LifeTime.single(),
      );
      const InMemoryDbModule().bind(di);
      eventStore = di.resolve<RawEventStore>();
      outboxDao = di.resolve<OutboxDaoInterface>();

      final cryptoService = CryptoService.create(
        Uint8List.fromList(SomeMokedData.randomBytes),
      );
      await cryptoService.init();

      sessionUsecase = SessionUsecase()
        ..setSession(
          const Session.unlocked(
            keys: NotesFixtures.keys,
            pin: NotesFixtures.pin,
          ),
        );

      noteCryptoUseCase = NoteCryptoUseCase(
        cryptoService: cryptoService,
        sessionUsecase: sessionUsecase,
        extraDerivation: ExtraDerivation(
          cryptoService: cryptoService,
          sessionUsecase: sessionUsecase,
        ),
      );

      exportSut = ExportUsecaseImpl(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
      );

      importSut = ImportUsecaseImpl(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        sessionUsecase: sessionUsecase,
        outboxDao: outboxDao,
      );
    });

    tearDown(() async {
      sessionUsecase.dispose();
      await DiStorage.shared.resolve<AppDatabase>().close();
      DiStorage.shared.removeAll();
    });

    // Seeds the backup with the original note1, exports it, then replaces the
    // stored note with a diverged local edit under the SAME d-tag. Returns the
    // backup path; the store ends up holding only the local version, so the
    // import below hits a d-tag collision.
    Future<String> seedBackupThenDivergeLocally({
      required String localContent,
    }) async {
      final backupNote = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
        NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
      );

      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: backupNote,
      );

      final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
        password: password,
        fileUri: '',
      );

      await _clearNotes(eventStore);
      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: backupNote.copyWith(
          content: localContent,
          summary: 'local summary',
        ),
      );

      return exportPath;
    }

    test('returns empty bytes when no notes in the store', () async {
      final (_, resultBytes, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
        password: password,
        fileUri: '',
      );
      expect(resultBytes, isEmpty);
    });

    test('exports plaintext content when password is empty', () async {
      final note = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
        NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
      );

      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: note,
      );

      final (filePath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
        password: '',
        fileUri: '',
      );
      addTearDown(() => File(filePath).deleteSync());

      final payload = _readExportJson(filePath);

      expect(payload.encrypted, isFalse);
      expect(payload.salt, isNull);
      expect(payload.iterations, isNull);

      final eventMap = payload.events.first;
      final nostrEvent = NostrEvent.fromJson(eventMap);

      expect(nostrEvent.content, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content));
      expect(
        _findTag(nostrEvent.tags as List<dynamic>, 'summary'),
        equals(NotesFixtures.event1Summary),
      );
      expect(
        nostrEvent.getTagsList(Note.labelsTag).first,
        equals(NotesFixtures.event1Labels),
      );
    });

    test(
      'encrypted export JSON has encrypted flag, salt, and iterations',
      () async {
        final note = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
        );

        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: note,
        );

        final (filePath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
          password: password,
          fileUri: '',
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(filePath).deleteSync());

        final payload = _readExportJson(filePath);

        expect(payload.encrypted, isTrue);
        expect(payload.salt, isA<String>());
        expect(payload.salt, isNotEmpty);
        expect(payload.iterations, equals(600000));
      },
    );

    test('creates a valid ZIP file containing notes_export.json', () async {
      final note = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
        NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
      );

      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: note,
      );

      final (filePath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
        password: password,
        fileUri: '',
      );
      addTearDown(() => File(filePath).deleteSync());

      expect(filePath, isNotEmpty);
      expect(File(filePath).existsSync(), isTrue);
      expect(
        ZipDecoder()
            .decodeBytes(File(filePath).readAsBytesSync())
            .findFile(ExportUsecaseImpl.archivedFileName),
        isNotNull,
      );
    });

    test('export JSON has correct structure and one event per note', () async {
      // eventJson2 is used here to verify its specific event ID is preserved
      final note = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
        NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson2)!,
      );

      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: note,
      );

      final (filePath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
        password: password,
        fileUri: '',
      );
      addTearDown(() => File(filePath).deleteSync());

      final payload = _readExportJson(filePath);

      expect(payload.version, equals(1));
      expect(payload.encrypted, isTrue);
      expect(payload.iterations, equals(600000));
      expect(payload.salt, isNotEmpty);
      expect(payload.events, hasLength(1));

      final event = payload.events.first;
      expect(
        event['id'],
        equals(
          'abd1e0dd92bdd51e7b08f56822b72177ea8e4b303f3817865f44beccdc193ea4',
        ),
      );
      expect(event['kind'], equals(EventKind.note.value));
      expect(
        _findTag(event['tags'] as List<dynamic>, 'd'),
        equals('ca980f90-22c9-11f1-b2b7-af1d94bcfeaf'),
      );
    });

    test(
      'encrypted fields (content, summary, labels) contain iv and mac markers',
      () async {
        final note = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
        );

        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: note,
        );

        final (filePath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
          password: password,
          fileUri: '',
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(filePath).deleteSync());

        final payload = _readExportJson(filePath);
        final event = payload.events.first;

        final encryptedContent = event['content'] as String;
        expect(encryptedContent, isNot(equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content)));
        expect(encryptedContent, contains('?iv='));
        expect(encryptedContent, contains('&mac='));

        final encryptedSummary = _findTag(
          event['tags'] as List<dynamic>,
          'summary',
        );
        expect(encryptedSummary, isNot(equals(NotesFixtures.event1Summary)));
        expect(encryptedSummary, contains('?iv='));
        expect(encryptedSummary, contains('&mac='));

        final encryptedLabels = _findTag(
          event['tags'] as List<dynamic>,
          Note.labelsTag,
        );
        expect(encryptedLabels, isNot(equals(NotesFixtures.event1Labels)));
        expect(encryptedLabels, contains('?iv='));
        expect(encryptedLabels, contains('&mac='));
      },
    );

    test('encrypted content can be decrypted back to original', () async {
      final note1 = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
        NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
      );
      final note2 = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
        NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson2)!,
      );

      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: note1,
      );
      await _seedEncryptedNote(
        eventStore: eventStore,
        noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
        note: note2,
      );

      final (filePath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
        password: password,
        fileUri: '',
      );
      addTearDown(() => File(filePath).deleteSync());

      final payload = _readExportJson(filePath);
      final salt = HexToBytes.hexToBytes(payload.salt!);
      expect(payload.events, hasLength(2));

      Map<String, dynamic> findById(String id) =>
          payload.events.firstWhere((e) => e['id'] == id);

      final ev1 = findById(
        'a826d76e943cab49f4d10cbc7c609e8b2f34c1f215ac4db7d4a55af96aa57dbd',
      );
      final ev2 = findById(
        'abd1e0dd92bdd51e7b08f56822b72177ea8e4b303f3817865f44beccdc193ea4',
      );

      expect(
        await _decryptExportField(
          ev1['content'] as String,
          password: password,
          salt: salt,
        ),
        equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content),
      );
      expect(
        await _decryptExportField(
          _findTag(ev1['tags'] as List<dynamic>, 'summary'),
          password: password,
          salt: salt,
        ),
        equals(NotesFixtures.event1Summary),
      );
      expect(
        await _decryptExportField(
          _findTag(ev1['tags'] as List<dynamic>, Note.labelsTag),
          password: password,
          salt: salt,
        ),
        equals(NotesFixtures.event1Labels),
      );
      expect(
        await _decryptExportField(
          ev2['content'] as String,
          password: password,
          salt: salt,
        ),
        equals(NotesFixtures.event2Content),
      );
      expect(
        await _decryptExportField(
          _findTag(ev2['tags'] as List<dynamic>, 'summary'),
          password: password,
          salt: salt,
        ),
        equals(NotesFixtures.event2Summary),
      );
    });

    group('importNotes', () {
      test('throws when file does not exist', () async {
        await expectLater(
          importSut.importNotes(
            password: password,
            filePath: '/tmp/nonexistent.zip',
          ),
          throwsA(isA<Exception>()),
        );
      });

      test('imported notes are queued in outbox for publishing', () async {
        final original = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
        );
        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: original,
        );

        final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
          password: password,
          fileUri: '',
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

        await _clearNotes(eventStore);

        await importSut.importNotes(password: password, filePath: exportPath);

        final pending = await outboxDao.getPending();
        expect(pending, hasLength(1));
        expect(pending.first.eventId, isNotEmpty);
      });

      test('imported notes are published to relay', () async {
        final channelFactory = _MockChannelFactory();
        final channel = MockWSChannel(url: MockRelaysListRepo.relayUrl1);
        when(
          () => channelFactory.create(MockRelaysListRepo.relayUrl1),
        ).thenReturn(channel);

        channel.onAdd = (data, ch) {
          final parsed = jsonDecode(data as String) as List<dynamic>;
          if (parsed.first == 'EVENT') {
            final eventId =
                (parsed[1] as Map<String, dynamic>)['id'] as String;
            ch.mockStream.add('["OK","$eventId",true,""]');
          }
        };

        final publisher = OutboxPublisher(
          outboxDao: outboxDao,
          rawEventStore: eventStore,
          relaysListRepo:
              MockRelaysListRepo.withRelays({MockRelaysListRepo.relayUrl1}),
          channelFactory: channelFactory,
          connectivity: _MockConnectivity(),
        );
        addTearDown(publisher.dispose);
        await publisher.init();

        final original = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
        );
        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: original,
        );

        final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
          password: password,
          fileUri: '',
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

        await _clearNotes(eventStore);

        await importSut.importNotes(password: password, filePath: exportPath);

        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));

        expect(channel.verifyAddCalled(), 1);

        final pending = await outboxDao.getPending();
        expect(pending, isEmpty);
      });

      test(
        'round-trip (encrypted): content, summary and labels survive export → import',
        () async {
          final original = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
          );

          await _seedEncryptedNote(
            eventStore: eventStore,
            noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
            note: original,
          );

          final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
            password: password,
            fileUri: '',
          );
          addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

          await _clearNotes(eventStore);

          await importSut.importNotes(
            password: password,
            filePath: exportPath,
          );

          final storedEvents = await eventStore.queryEvents(
            RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
          );
          expect(storedEvents, isNotEmpty);

          final decrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(storedEvents.first)!,
          );
          expect(decrypted.content, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content));
          expect(decrypted.summary, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Summary));
          expect(decrypted.labels, equals(original.labels));
          expect(
            (decrypted.labels.first as Label).type,
            equals(CategoryType.security),
          );
        },
      );

      test(
        'round-trip (plaintext): content, summary and labels survive export → import',
        () async {
          final original = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
          );

          await _seedEncryptedNote(
            eventStore: eventStore,
            noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
            note: original,
          );

          final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
            password: '',
            fileUri: '',
          );
          addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

          await _clearNotes(eventStore);

          await importSut.importNotes(password: '', filePath: exportPath);

          final storedEvents = await eventStore.queryEvents(
            RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
          );
          expect(storedEvents, isNotEmpty);

          final decrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(storedEvents.first)!,
          );
          expect(decrypted.content, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content));
          expect(decrypted.summary, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Summary));
          expect(decrypted.labels, equals(original.labels));
          expect(
            (decrypted.labels.first as Label).type,
            equals(CategoryType.security),
          );
        },
      );

      test('import with wrong password throws on decryption', () async {
        final note = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
        );

        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: note,
        );

        final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
          password: password,
          fileUri: '',
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

        await expectLater(
          importSut.importNotes(
            password: 'wrong_password',
            filePath: exportPath,
          ),
          throwsA(anything),
        );
      });

      test('no collision: original d-tags are preserved', () async {
        final note1 = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
        );
        final note2 = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson2)!,
        );

        // Backup contains note1 + note2.
        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: note1,
        );
        await _seedEncryptedNote(
          eventStore: eventStore,
          noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
          note: note2,
        );

        final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
          password: password,
          fileUri: '',
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

        // Empty store before import → no collisions for any policy.
        await _clearNotes(eventStore);

        await importSut.importNotes(
          password: password,
          filePath: exportPath,
        );

        final all = await eventStore.queryEvents(
          RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
        );
        expect(all, hasLength(2));
        final dTags = all.map((e) => e.getDTag()).toSet();
        expect(dTags, equals({note1.dTag, note2.dTag}));
      });

      test(
        'keepIncoming: imported note overwrites the diverged local one',
        () async {
          final exportPath = await seedBackupThenDivergeLocally(
            localContent: 'Local edit',
          );
          addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

          await importSut.importNotes(
            password: password,
            filePath: exportPath,
            policy: const ImportPolicy.keepIncoming(),
          );

          final all = await eventStore.queryEvents(
            RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
          );
          // Same d-tag → replaced, not duplicated.
          expect(all, hasLength(1));

          final decrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(all.first)!,
          );
          expect(decrypted.content, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content));
        },
      );

      test('keepExisting: the stored local note wins', () async {
        const localContent = 'Local edit kept on conflict';
        final exportPath = await seedBackupThenDivergeLocally(
          localContent: localContent,
        );
        addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

        await importSut.importNotes(
          password: password,
          filePath: exportPath,
          policy: const ImportPolicy.keepExisting(),
        );

        final all = await eventStore.queryEvents(
          RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
        );
        expect(all, hasLength(1));

        final decrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
          NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(all.first)!,
        );
        expect(decrypted.content, equals(localContent));
      });

      test(
        'mergeContent: concatenates both contents and regenerates summary',
        () async {
          const localContent = 'LOCAL note body';
          final exportPath = await seedBackupThenDivergeLocally(
            localContent: localContent,
          );
          addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

          await importSut.importNotes(
            password: password,
            filePath: exportPath,
            policy: const ImportPolicy.mergeContent(),
          );

          final all = await eventStore.queryEvents(
            RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
          );
          // Same d-tag → merged in place, not duplicated.
          expect(all, hasLength(1));

          final decrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(all.first)!,
          );
          // Existing content first, then the imported one.
          expect(decrypted.content, startsWith(localContent));
          expect(decrypted.content, contains(MergeContent.separator));
          expect(decrypted.content, contains(NotesFixtures.event1Content));
          // Summary is regenerated from the merged content (no longer stale).
          expect(decrypted.summary, contains(localContent));
        },
      );
    });

    group('cross-account import', () {
      test(
        'export with account A → import to account B → content, summary and labels decryptable only by B',
        () async {
          final original = await noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromJsonStr(NotesFixtures.eventJson1)!,
          );

          await _seedEncryptedNote(
            eventStore: eventStore,
            noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoUseCase,
            note: original,
          );

          final (exportPath, _, _) = await exportSut.exportNotes(
            password: password,
            fileUri: '',
          );
          addTearDown(() => File(exportPath).deleteSync());

          await _clearNotes(eventStore);

          // ── Account B ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          const privateKeyB =
              'b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c762e7160f38b4da56a784d9045190cfef';
          final publicKeyB = KeyTool.tryGetPubKey(privateKey: privateKeyB)!;

          final cryptoServiceB = CryptoService.create(
            Uint8List.fromList(SomeMokedData.randomBytes),
          );
          await cryptoServiceB.init();

          final sessionB = SessionUsecase()
            ..setSession(
              Session.unlocked(
                keys: UserKeys(privateKey: privateKeyB, publicKey: publicKeyB),
                pin: '5678',
              ),
            );
          addTearDown(sessionB.dispose);

          final noteCryptoB = NoteCryptoUseCase(
            cryptoService: cryptoServiceB,
            sessionUsecase: sessionB,
            extraDerivation: ExtraDerivation(
              cryptoService: cryptoServiceB,
              sessionUsecase: sessionB,
            ),
          );

          final importSutB = ImportUsecaseImpl(
            eventStore: eventStore,
            noteCryptoUseCase: noteCryptoB,
            sessionUsecase: sessionB,
            outboxDao: outboxDao,
          );

          await importSutB.importNotes(
            password: password,
            filePath: exportPath,
          );

          final storedEvents = await eventStore.queryEvents(
            RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
          );
          expect(storedEvents, isNotEmpty);

          // Account B can decrypt content, summary and labels
          final decryptedByB = await noteCryptoB.decryptNote(
            NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(storedEvents.first)!,
          );
          expect(decryptedByB.content, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Content));
          expect(decryptedByB.summary, equals(NotesFixtures.event1Summary));
          expect(decryptedByB.labels, equals(original.labels));
          expect(
            (decryptedByB.labels.first as Label).type,
            equals(CategoryType.security),
          );

          // Account A cannot decrypt (different NIP-44 conversation key)
          await expectLater(
            noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(
              NoteMapper.fromNostrEvent(storedEvents.first)!,
            ),
            throwsA(anything),
          );
        },
      );
    });
  });
}

// ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Future<void> _seedEncryptedNote({
  required RawEventStore eventStore,
  required NoteCryptoUseCase noteCryptoUseCase,
  required Note note,
}) async {
  final encrypted = await noteCryptoUseCase.encryptNote(note);
  await eventStore.upsert([
    NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(encrypted, pubkey: NotesFixtures.keys.publicKey),
  ]);
}

Future<void> _clearNotes(RawEventStore eventStore) async {
  final events = await eventStore.queryEvents(
    RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
  );
  if (events.isNotEmpty) {
    await eventStore.deleteEvents(events.map((e) => e.id).toSet());
  }
}

BackupPayload _readExportJson(String zipFilePath) {
  final archive = ZipDecoder().decodeBytes(File(zipFilePath).readAsBytesSync());
  final jsonBytes =
      archive.findFile(ExportUsecaseImpl.archivedFileName)!.content
          as List<int>;
  return BackupPayload.fromJson(
    jsonDecode(utf8.decode(jsonBytes)) as Map<String, dynamic>,
  );
}

String _findTag(List<dynamic> tags, String name) {
  final tag =
      tags.firstWhere((t) => (t as List<dynamic>).first == name)
          as List<dynamic>;
  return tag[1] as String;
}

Future<String> _decryptExportField(
  String encoded, {
  required String password,
  required Uint8List salt,
}) async {
  final parts = encoded.split('?iv=');
  final cipherText = base64Decode(parts[0]);
  final ivAndMac = parts[1].split('&mac=');
  final iv = base64Decode(ivAndMac[0]);
  final mac = Mac(base64Decode(ivAndMac[1]));

  final secretKey = await Pbkdf2(
    macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
    iterations: 600000,
    bits: 256,
  ).deriveKeyFromPassword(password: password, nonce: salt);

  final plainBytes = await AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256())
      .decrypt(
        SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
        secretKey: secretKey,
      );

  return utf8.decode(plainBytes);
}

class _MockConnectivity implements Connectivity {
  @override
  Future<List<ConnectivityResult>> checkConnectivity() async => [
    ConnectivityResult.wifi,
  ];

  @override
  Stream<List<ConnectivityResult>> get onConnectivityChanged =>
      const Stream.empty();
}
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-09 15:35:57Z)**_

Хороший вопрос — это ключевая проблема при использовании envied в CI/CD. Есть два подхода:

---

## Вариант A: `.env` создаётся в CI из секретов (рекомендую)

`.env` gitignored, но `env.g.dart` тоже. Значит CI должен сначала создать `.env`, потом запустить codegen.

**GitHub Actions:**
```yaml
- name: Create .env
  env:
    DEV_LIGHTNING_ADDRESS: ${{ secrets.DEV_LIGHTNING_ADDRESS }}
    DEV_NOSTR_PUBKEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_NOSTR_PUBKEY }}
    KOFI_URL: ${{ secrets.KOFI_URL }}
  run: |
    printf "DEV_LIGHTNING_ADDRESS=%s\n" "$DEV_LIGHTNING_ADDRESS" >  packages/notes/.env
    printf "DEV_NOSTR_PUBKEY=%s\n"      "$DEV_NOSTR_PUBKEY"      >> packages/notes/.env
    printf "KOFI_URL=%s\n"             "$KOFI_URL"              >> packages/notes/.env

- name: Codegen
  run: cd packages/notes && fvm flutter pub run build_runner build
```

Секреты добавить в репо: **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions**.

**Fastlane (Fastfile):**
```ruby
lane :build_release do
  sh(
    "printf 'DEV_LIGHTNING_ADDRESS=%s\\n' '#{ENV.fetch('DEV_LIGHTNING_ADDRESS')}' " \
    "> ../packages/notes/.env && " \
    "printf 'DEV_NOSTR_PUBKEY=%s\\n' '#{ENV.fetch('DEV_NOSTR_PUBKEY')}' " \
    ">> ../packages/notes/.env && " \
    "printf 'KOFI_URL=%s\\n' '#{ENV.fetch('KOFI_URL')}' " \
    ">> ../packages/notes/.env"
  )
  sh "cd .. && make codegen"
  # ... gradle / xcodebuild
end
```

Fastlane читает значения из переменных окружения, которые GH Actions пробрасывает через `env:`.

---

## Вариант B: Закоммитить `env.g.dart` (проще, но менее строго)

Убрать `lib/app/env.g.dart` из `.gitignore`. Сам файл содержит только XOR-обфусцированные значения — без `.env` восстановить их практически невозможно. Многие проекты с `envied` так и делают.

Тогда CI/CD не нужно ничего знать о секретах — `env.g.dart` уже в репо.

**Минус:** при смене значений надо регенерировать и коммитить `env.g.dart` вручную.

---

## Что выбрать

| | Вариант A | Вариант B |
|---|---|---|
| Значения в репо | Нет | Только XOR'd |
| Настройка CI | Нужны секреты + codegen шаг | Ничего лишнего |
| Смена значений | `.env` → `make codegen` → commit | То же + commit `env.g.dart` |
| Fork contributors | Нужен свой `.env` + secrets | Работает из коробки |

Для публичного репо с личными данными — **Вариант A**. Если хочется максимально простой CI — **Вариант B** (obfuscation достаточна для lightning address и pubkey).

## Монетизация через рекламу: план действий

### Шаг 1: AdMob аккаунт

1. Зайти на [admob.google.com](https://admob.google.com) — логин через Google аккаунт
2. Принять условия, заполнить платёжную информацию (страна, налоговая форма)
3. **Добавить приложения**: Apps → Add app
   - Добавить Android-приложение (по bundle ID `com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes`) — привязать к Google Play Console
   - Добавить iOS-приложение — привязать к App Store Connect
   - Каждое приложение получит **AdMob App ID** формата `ca-app-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX~XXXXXXXXXX`

### Шаг 2: Создать рекламные блоки

Для каждого приложения (Android + iOS): Apps → выбрать приложение → Ad units → Add ad unit

Тип: **Interstitial** (полноэкранная, показывается перед действием — идеально для импорта/экспорта)

Каждый блок даст **Ad Unit ID** формата `ca-app-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/XXXXXXXXXX`.

Итого нужно создать 4 ID:
| | Android | iOS |
|---|---|---|
| Перед экспортом | `ca-app-pub-.../...` | `ca-app-pub-.../...` |
| Перед импортом | `ca-app-pub-.../...` | `ca-app-pub-.../...` |

Можно использовать один блок для обоих действий — на своё усмотрение.

### Шаг 3: Privacy compliance

**iOS (обязательно)** — App Tracking Transparency (ATT):
- App Store Connect → ваше приложение → App Privacy → заполнить раздел "Advertising"
- В `Info.plist` потребуется ключ `NSUserTrackingUsageDescription`

**GDPR / EU** — подключить `User Messaging Platform` (UMP SDK, входит в `google_mobile_ads`):
- В AdMob: Privacy & messaging → GDPR message → создать шаблон согласия
- UMP показывает диалог согласия при первом запуске для пользователей из EU

### Шаг 4: Интеграция в проект

**4.1** Добавить зависимость в [packages/notes/pubspec.yaml](packages/notes/pubspec.yaml):
```yaml
dependencies:
  google_mobile_ads: ^5.3.0
```

**4.2** Android — добавить App ID в `AndroidManifest.xml`:
```xml
<meta-data
    android:name="com.google.android.gms.ads.APPLICATION_ID"
    android:value="ca-app-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX~XXXXXXXXXX"/>
```

**4.3** iOS — добавить в `Info.plist`:
```xml
<key>GADApplicationIdentifier</key>
<string>ca-app-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX~XXXXXXXXXX</string>
<key>NSUserTrackingUsageDescription</key>
<string>This identifier will be used to deliver personalized ads to you.</string>
```

**4.4** Создать `AdService` — сервис загрузки и показа рекламы:
```dart
// packages/notes/lib/services/ad_service.dart
final class AdService {
  InterstitialAd? _interstitialAd;

  static const _androidAdUnitId = 'ca-app-pub-.../...';
  static const _iosAdUnitId = 'ca-app-pub-.../...';

  static String get _adUnitId =>
      Platform.isAndroid ? _androidAdUnitId : _iosAdUnitId;

  Future<void> loadInterstitial() async {
    await InterstitialAd.load(
      adUnitId: _adUnitId,
      request: const AdRequest(),
      adLoadCallback: InterstitialAdLoadCallback(
        onAdLoaded: (ad) => _interstitialAd = ad,
        onAdFailedToLoad: (_) => _interstitialAd = null,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> showInterstitial() async {
    final ad = _interstitialAd;
    if (ad == null) return;
    _interstitialAd = null;
    final completer = Completer<void>();
    ad.fullScreenContentCallback = FullScreenContentCallback(
      onAdDismissedFullScreenContent: (_) => completer.complete(),
      onAdFailedToShowFullScreenContent: (_, __) => completer.complete(),
    );
    await ad.show();
    await completer.future;
  }
}
```

**4.5** Инициализация при старте приложения (в `main.dart` или DI):
```dart
await MobileAds.instance.initialize();
```

**4.6** В [export_import_screen.dart](packages/notes/lib/auth/presentation/settings/export_import/export_import_screen.dart) — перед вызовом экспорта/импорта:
```dart
// При нажатии Export:
await _adService.showInterstitial();
bloc.add(ExportImportEvent.export(...));
// Параллельно загружать следующую рекламу:
unawaited(_adService.loadInterstitial());
```

**4.7** DI — зарегистрировать `AdService` в `bindAuthModules()` или `bindUnauthModules()`.

---

### На тестовом этапе

AdMob предоставляет тестовые ID (до одобрения реального аккаунта):
```dart
// Android test
static const _androidAdUnitId = 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1033173712';
// iOS test  
static const _iosAdUnitId = 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/4411468910';
```

Реальные ID можно подставить через `.env` / `AppEnv` — по той же схеме, что уже сделано.

---

### Порядок работы

```
AdMob аккаунт → создать приложения → создать ad units → взять ID
→ pubspec + AndroidManifest + Info.plist
→ AdService + DI
→ интеграция в export_import_screen
→ тест на тестовых ID
→ заменить на боевые ID
→ сабмит в App Store (указать рекламу в App Privacy)
```

```text
156	    "helpScreenContent": "# Private Notes (Nostr)\n\nPrivate Notes (Nostr) is a private, encrypted note-taking app built on the **Nostr** protocol. Your notes are encrypted on your device and synced through decentralized relays — no company owns your data.\n\n\n## What is Nostr?\n\nNostr (Notes and Other Stuff Transmitted by Relays) is an open, decentralized protocol. Instead of a central server, it uses a network of **relays** — independent servers that store and forward your data. Your identity is a cryptographic key pair, not an email or phone number.\n\n\n## Key Concepts\n\n### 🔑 Nsec (Private Key)\n\nYour **nsec** is your master key. It starts with `nsec1...` and is the bech32 encoding of your private key (hex). It is used to:\n\n- **Sign** your notes so relays can verify they come from you\n- **Encrypt** and **decrypt** your note content\n- **Prove ownership** of your account\n\n> ⚠️ **Never share your nsec with anyone.** Anyone who has it gains full control of your account. There is no \"forgot password\" — if you lose your nsec, your data is gone forever.\n\nYour nsec is stored only on this device in secure storage (Keychain on iOS, Keystore on Android). It is never sent to any server.\n\n### 🌐 Public Key (npub)\n\nYour **public key** (displayed as `npub1...`) is your public identity on the Nostr network. It is derived from your nsec and is safe to share. Anyone can use it to look up your profile across Nostr apps.\n\n### 🔒 PIN / Password\n\nThe PIN provides an **extra layer of encryption** on top of your nsec. Even if someone obtains your private key, they still cannot read your notes without the PIN.\n\nImportant details:\n\n- The PIN is **never saved to disk** — it lives only in memory while the app is open\n- If you **forget your PIN**, existing notes **cannot be decrypted**\n- If you enter a **wrong PIN**, new or edited notes will be encrypted with that incorrect PIN, making them unreadable with the correct one\n\n### 📡 Relays\n\nRelays are servers that store and deliver your encrypted notes. You can choose which relays to use in **Settings → Preferences → Connected Relays**. Using multiple relays increases redundancy — if one goes offline, your data is still available on others.\n\n\n## How It Works\n\n1. **Create** a note in the editor\n2. The note is **encrypted** on your device using NIP-44 encryption with your nsec and PIN\n3. The encrypted note is **signed** and **published** to your selected relays\n4. When you open the app, notes are **fetched** from relays and **decrypted** locally\n\nNo one — not the relay operators, not us — can read your notes. Only you, with your nsec and PIN, can decrypt them.\n\n\n## Tips\n\n- **Back up your nsec** in a secure place (e.g., a password manager). Without it, your account cannot be recovered.\n- **Remember your PIN.** It is not stored anywhere and cannot be reset.\n- **Use multiple relays** for better availability and redundancy.\n- Your nsec works across all Nostr apps — you can use the same identity everywhere.",
```

```text
5	
6	mixin LinkTapHandler on StatelessWidget {
7	  Future<void> launchUrl(BuildContext context, {required String? url}) async {
8	    if (url == null || url.isEmpty) {
9	      return;
10	    }
11	    final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
12	    try {
13	      if (uri != null && await launcher.canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
14	        await launcher.launchUrl(uri);
15	      } else {
16	        if (context.mounted) {
17	          await _copyToClipboard(context, url);
18	        }
19	      }
20	    } catch (e) {
21	      if (context.mounted) {
22	        await _copyToClipboard(context, url);
23	      }
24	    }
25	  }
26	
27	  Future<void> _copyToClipboard(BuildContext context, String text) async {
28	    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
29	    if (context.mounted) {
30	      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
31	        SnackBar(
32	          content: Column(
33	            children: [
34	              Text('${context.commonL10n.commonCopied}:'),
35	              Text(_sanitarizeUrl(text)),
36	            ],
37	          ),
38	        ),
39	      );
40	    }
41	  }
42	
43	  String _sanitarizeUrl(String url) {
44	    String result = url.trim();
45	
46	    if (result.startsWith('mailto:')) {
47	      result = result.substring(7);
48	    } else if (result.startsWith('tel:')) {
49	      result = result.substring(4);
50	    }
51	    return result;
52	  }
53	}
```

```text
  Future<CommonLocalizations> load(Locale locale) {
    return SynchronousFuture<CommonLocalizations>(
      lookupCommonLocalizations(locale),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool isSupported(Locale locale) =>
      <String>['en', 'ru'].contains(locale.languageCode);

  @override
  bool shouldReload(_CommonLocalizationsDelegate old) => false;
}

CommonLocalizations lookupCommonLocalizations(Locale locale) {
  // Lookup logic when only language code is specified.
  switch (locale.languageCode) {
    case 'en':
      return CommonLocalizationsEn();
    case 'ru':
      return CommonLocalizationsRu();
  }

  throw FlutterError(
    'CommonLocalizations.delegate failed to load unsupported locale "$locale". This is likely '
    'an issue with the localizations generation tool. Please file an issue '
    'on GitHub with a reproducible sample app and the gen-l10n configuration '
    'that was used.',
  );
}
```

```dart
import 'package:common/app/theme/gpt_markdown_theme_data.dart';
import 'package:common/app/theme/sizes.dart';
import 'package:common/l10n/localization.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:gpt_markdown/custom_widgets/markdown_config.dart';
import 'package:gpt_markdown/gpt_markdown.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart' as launcher;

class GptMarkdownWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final String md;
  final CodeBlockBuilder? codeBuilder;
  final OrderedListBuilder? orderedListBuilder;
  final HighlightBuilder? highlightBuilder;

  const GptMarkdownWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.md,
    this.codeBuilder,
    this.orderedListBuilder,
    this.highlightBuilder,
  });

  @override
  State<GptMarkdownWidget> createState() => _GptMarkdownWidgetState();
}

class _GptMarkdownWidgetState extends State<GptMarkdownWidget> {
  Offset _tapPosition = Offset.zero;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mdTheme = Theme.of(context).extension<AppGptMarkdownTheme>()!;
    return Listener(
      onPointerDown: (event) => _tapPosition = event.position,
      child: GptMarkdownTheme(
        gptThemeData: mdTheme.data,
        child: GptMarkdown(
          widget.md,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: TextSizes.normal),
          codeBuilder: widget.codeBuilder,
          highlightBuilder: widget.highlightBuilder,
          orderedListBuilder: widget.orderedListBuilder,
          onLinkTap: (url, title) => _onLinkTap(url),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _onLinkTap(String? url) async {
    if (url == null || url.isEmpty) return;
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
    if (uri == null) return;

    bool canOpen = false;
    try {
      canOpen = await launcher.canLaunchUrl(uri);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!mounted) return;

    if (!canOpen) {
      await _copyToClipboard(url);
      return;
    }

    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final l10n = context.commonL10n;
    final screenSize = MediaQuery.of(context).size;
    final position = RelativeRect.fromLTRB(
      _tapPosition.dx,
      _tapPosition.dy,
      screenSize.width - _tapPosition.dx,
      screenSize.height - _tapPosition.dy,
    );

    final result = await showMenu<_LinkMenuAction>(
      context: context,
      color: theme.colorScheme.surface.withValues(alpha: 0.90),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(Sizes.radiusVariant)),
      ),
      shadowColor: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
      position: position,
      items: [
        _menuItem(_LinkMenuAction.copyLink, Icons.link, l10n.commonLinkCopyLink),
        _menuItem(_LinkMenuAction.openInBrowser, Icons.open_in_browser_outlined, l10n.commonLinkOpenInBrowser),
        _menuItem(_LinkMenuAction.openInExternalBrowser, Icons.open_in_new, l10n.commonLinkOpenInExternalBrowser),
      ],
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    switch (result) {
      case _LinkMenuAction.copyLink:
        await _copyToClipboard(url);
      case _LinkMenuAction.openInBrowser:
        await launcher.launchUrl(uri);
      case _LinkMenuAction.openInExternalBrowser:
        await launcher.launchUrl(uri, mode: launcher.LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      case null:
        break;
    }
  }

  PopupMenuItem<_LinkMenuAction> _menuItem(
    _LinkMenuAction value,
    IconData icon,
    String title,
  ) {
    return PopupMenuItem(
      value: value,
      height: 32,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: Sizes.indent),
        child: Row(
          spacing: Sizes.indent,
          children: [
            Icon(icon, size: Sizes.iconSmall),
            Text(title),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _copyToClipboard(String url) async {
    String text = url.trim();
    if (text.startsWith('mailto:')) {
      text = text.substring(7);
    } else if (text.startsWith('tel:')) {
      text = text.substring(4);
    }
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Column(
            children: [
              Text('${context.commonL10n.commonCopied}:'),
              Text(text),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}

enum _LinkMenuAction { copyLink, openInBrowser, openInExternalBrowser }

```

```text
1	import 'dart:developer';

3	import 'package:collection/collection.dart';
4	import 'package:nostr_notes/auth/domain/model/note.dart';
5	import 'package:nostr_notes/auth/domain/repo/notes_repository.dart';
6	import 'package:nostr_notes/auth/domain/usecase/note_crypto_use_case.dart';
7	import 'package:common/domain/error/app_error.dart';
8	import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/usecase/session_usecase.dart';
9	import 'package:rxdart/rxdart.dart';
10	
11	class GetNotesUsecase {
12	  final NotesRepository _notesRepository;
13	  final SessionUsecase _sessionUsecase;
14	  final NoteCryptoUseCase _noteCryptoUseCase;
15	
16	  GetNotesUsecase({
17	    required NotesRepository notesRepository,
18	    required SessionUsecase sessionUsecase,
19	    required NoteCryptoUseCase noteCryptoUseCase,
20	  }) : _notesRepository = notesRepository,
21	       _sessionUsecase = sessionUsecase,
22	       _noteCryptoUseCase = noteCryptoUseCase;
23	
24	  Stream<List<Note>> execute() {
25	    final keys = _sessionUsecase.currentSession.keys;
26	    final publicKey = keys?.publicKey;
27	
28	    if (publicKey == null || publicKey.isEmpty) {
29	      throw const AppError.notAuthenticated();
30	    }
31	
32	    return _notesRepository.watchNotes(pubkey: publicKey).switchMap((items) {
33	      if (items.isEmpty) {
34	        return Stream.value(<Note>[]);
35	      }
36	
37	      return Stream.fromFuture(_decryptNotes(items)).map((decryptedNotes) {
38	        return decryptedNotes.sorted(
39	          (a, b) => b.updatedAt.compareTo(a.updatedAt),
40	        );
41	      });
42	    });
43	  }
44	
45	  Future<Iterable<Note>> _decryptNotes(Iterable<Note> notes) async {
46	    final decryptedNotes = <Note>[];
47	
48	    for (final note in notes) {
49	      try {
50	        final decryptedNote = await _noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(note);
51	        decryptedNotes.add(decryptedNote);
52	      } catch (e, s) {
53	        log('Failed to decrypt note ${note.dTag}: $e', stackTrace: s);
54	      }
55	    }
56	
57	    return decryptedNotes;
58	  }
59	}
```

```text
6	mixin NoteDecryptErrorMessageMixin {
7	  String buildDecryptErrorMessage({
8	    required AppLocalizations l10n,
9	    required CommonL10n commonL10n,
10	    required Object? error,
11	  }) {
12	    final base = l10n.notePreviewCannotDecryptDescription;
13	    if (error == null) {
14	      return base;
15	    }
16	
17	    final reason = humanReadableDecryptReason(
18	      l10n: l10n,
19	      commonL10n: commonL10n,
20	      error: error,
21	    );
22	    final details = error.toString().trim();
23	
24	    return [
25	      base,
26	      '${l10n.notesListDecryptLikelyReasonLabel}: $reason',
27	      if (details.isNotEmpty) '${l10n.notesListDecryptDetailsLabel}: $details',
28	    ].join('\n\n');
29	  }
30	
31	  String humanReadableDecryptReason({
32	    required AppLocalizations l10n,
33	    required Object error,
34	    required CommonL10n commonL10n,
35	  }) {
36	    switch (error) {
37	      case InvalidMacNip44Exception():
38	        return l10n.notesListDecryptReasonWrongPin;
39	      case InvalidPaddingNip44Exception() ||
40	          InvalidPayloadEncodingNip44Exception() ||
41	          InvalidPayloadSizeNip44Exception() ||
42	          UnsupportedVersionNip44Exception() ||
43	          UnknownVersionNip44Exception():
44	        return l10n.notesListDecryptReasonCorruptedPayload;
45	      case InvalidConversationKeyLengthNip44Exception() ||
46	          InvalidNonceLengthNip44Exception() ||
47	          InvalidPlaintextLengthNip44Exception() ||
48	          InvalidPublicKeyNip44Exception():
49	        return l10n.notesListDecryptReasonInvalidParams;
50	      case NotUnlockedError():
51	        return l10n.notUnlocked;
52	      case NotAuthenticatedError():
53	        return commonL10n.authError;
54	      case AppError():
55	        return error.message.isNotEmpty
56	            ? error.message
57	            : commonL10n.commonUndefinedError;
58	      default:
59	        return commonL10n.commonUndefinedError;
60	    }
61	  }
62	}
```
