```text
name: macOS TestFlight Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: macos-15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Select Xcode 26.2
        run: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_26.2.app/Contents/Developer

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.44.0'
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Install melos
        run: dart pub global activate melos

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: melos bootstrap

      - name: Build Flutter macOS
        working-directory: packages/notes
        run: flutter build macos --release --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/debug-info

      - name: Upload debug symbols
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-debug-symbols
          path: packages/notes/build/debug-info/

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: packages/notes/macos

      - name: Install Fastlane
        working-directory: packages/notes/macos
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install

      - name: Install Apple WWDR certificates
        run: |
          curl -sL -o /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG3.cer https://www.apple.com/certificateauthority/AppleWWDRCAG3.cer
          curl -sL -o /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG4.cer https://www.apple.com/certificateauthority/AppleWWDRCAG4.cer
          curl -sL -o /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG5.cer https://www.apple.com/certificateauthority/AppleWWDRCAG5.cer
          curl -sL -o /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG6.cer https://www.apple.com/certificateauthority/AppleWWDRCAG6.cer
          sudo security import /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG3.cer -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || true
          sudo security import /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG4.cer -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || true
          sudo security import /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG5.cer -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || true
          sudo security import /tmp/AppleWWDRCAG6.cer -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || true

      - name: Deploy to TestFlight
        working-directory: packages/notes/macos
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_BASE64: ${{ secrets.NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_BASE64 }}
          MATCH_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.NOSTR_NOTES_MATCH_PASSWORD }}
          MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION: ${{ secrets.NOSTR_NOTES_MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane beta
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
default_platform(:mac)

platform :mac do
  desc "Push a new build to TestFlight"
  lane :beta do
    setup_ci if ENV['CI']

    api_key_content = Base64.decode64(ENV['NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_BASE64'])

    api_key = app_store_connect_api_key(
      key_id: ENV['APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID'],
      issuer_id: ENV['APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID'],
      key_content: api_key_content
    )

    puts "api_key_content: #{ENV['NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_BASE64']}"
    puts "key_id: #{ENV['APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID']}"
    puts "issuer_id: #{ENV['APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID']}"
    puts "MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION: #{ENV['MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION']}"

    # TODO: Remove this workaround
    current_build_number = 24

    latest_build = latest_testflight_build_number(
      version: "1.0.1",
      api_key: api_key,
      app_identifier: "com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes",
      platform: "osx",
      initial_build_number: 2current_build_number3
    )

    if latest_build <= current_build_number
      latest_build = current_build_number
      puts "Latest build number is #{latest_build}, which is less than or equal to 10. Setting it to 10 to avoid issues with TestFlight."
    end


    increment_build_number(
      build_number: latest_build + 1,
      xcodeproj: "Runner.xcodeproj"
    )

    match(
      type: "appstore",
      platform: "macos",
      readonly: true,
      git_basic_authorization: ENV['MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION'],
      api_key: api_key,
      additional_cert_types: ["mac_installer_distribution"]
    )

    update_code_signing_settings(
      use_automatic_signing: false,
      path: "Runner.xcodeproj",
      team_id: "HCYSG3HDXK",
      bundle_identifier: "com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes",
      profile_name: "match AppStore com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes macos",
      code_sign_identity: "Apple Distribution"
    )

    build_mac_app(
      workspace: "Runner.xcworkspace",
      scheme: "Runner",
      export_method: "app-store"
    )

    upload_to_testflight(
      api_key: api_key,
      skip_waiting_for_build_processing: true
    )
  end
end
```

default_platform(:mac)

platform :mac do
  private_lane :_make_api_key do
    api_key_content = Base64.decode64(ENV['NOSTR_NOTES_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_BASE64'])

      key_content: api_key_content,
    )
  end

  private_lane :_install_signing_certs do |options|
    match(
      type: "appstore",
      platform: "macos",
      readonly: true,
      git_basic_authorization: ENV['MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION'],
      api_key: options[:api_key],
      additional_cert_types: ["mac_installer_distribution"],
    )
    update_code_signing_settings(
      use_automatic_signing: false,
      path: "Runner.xcodeproj",
      team_id: "HCYSG3HDXK",
      bundle_identifier: "com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes",
      profile_name: "match AppStore com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes macos",
      code_sign_identity: "Apple Distribution",
    )
  end

  desc "Install signing certificates — run before flutter build in CI"
  lane :install_certs do
    setup_ci if ENV['CI']
    _install_signing_certs(api_key: _make_api_key)
  end

  desc "Push a new build to TestFlight"
  lane :beta do
    setup_ci if ENV['CI']

    api_key = _make_api_key

    current_build_number = 24

    latest_build = latest_testflight_build_number(
      version: "1.0.1",
      api_key: api_key,
      app_identifier: "com.alekseii.yu.popkov.nostrNotes",
      platform: "osx",
      initial_build_number: current_build_number,
    )

    if latest_build <= current_build_number
      latest_build = current_build_number
    end

    increment_build_number(
      build_number: latest_build + 1,
      xcodeproj: "Runner.xcodeproj",
    )

    _install_signing_certs(api_key: api_key)

    build_mac_app(
      workspace: "Runner.xcworkspace",
      scheme: "Runner",
      export_method: "app-store",
    )

    upload_to_testflight(
      api_key: api_key,
      skip_waiting_for_build_processing: true,
    )
  end
end

| Абстракция + conditional imports | Ноль оверхеда для Android | Сложнее структура |

Для текущей ситуации (Android только как APK, небольшая аудитория) — я бы выбрал **вариант 1**: один pubspec, показывать только на iOS. Когда придёт время выходить в Play Store с рекламой — тогда вся инфраструктура уже будет готова.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-12 07:42:38Z)**_

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The user is asking about "Rewarded Interstitial" ad format in AdMob. Let me explain what it is and compare it to regular interstitial.
</details></think>

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-12 07:42:45Z)**_

**Rewarded Interstitial** — это гибрид между обычным интерстишлом и rewarded video:

- Показывается полноэкранно, как обычный interstitial
- Пользователь **не обязан** смотреть до конца (можно закрыть)
- Но если досмотрит — получает **награду** (монеты, жизни, разблокировка фичи и т.д.)
- Google рекомендует показывать в "natural breaks" — т.е. между действиями, не прерывая пользователя в середине задачи

**Отличие от обычного Interstitial:**

| | Interstitial | Rewarded Interstitial |
|---|---|---|
| Можно закрыть | Через 5 сек | Сразу |
| Награда за просмотр | Нет | Да (опционально) |
| Ощущение для пользователя | Навязанная реклама | Добровольная |
| CPM (доход) | Средний | Обычно выше |

**Для твоего случая** (перед export/import) — обычный **Interstitial** подходит лучше. Rewarded Interstitial имеет смысл когда есть что дать пользователю за просмотр (например, разблокировать какую-то premium-фичу на время). В приложении с заметками придумать органичную награду сложнее.

Beta-статус означает что формат ещё не полностью стабилен с точки зрения API и политик Google.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The user is asking about naming conventions for the AdMob environment variables. They're wondering if `ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ID_IOS` is clear enough or if they should include "full_screen" in the name.

The user's concern: if they add a banner later, would `ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ID_IOS` be confusing?

The answer: "Interstitial" IS the specific ad format name (full-screen between content). It's not generic - it specifically means full-screen. A banner would be `ADMOB_BANNER_ID_IOS`. So the naming is already clear and conventional.
Though they named their ad unit `full_screen_interstitial` in AdMob, sticking with `ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ID_IOS` follows the standard convention used in AdMob's Flutter documentation and examples. The term "interstitial" already carries the meaning of full-screen in advertising terminology, so there's no ambiguity—banners, rewarded ads, and other formats each have their own distinct names.
</details></think>

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-12 07:54:24Z)**_

`INTERSTITIAL` — это уже конкретный формат, а не просто "полноэкранный". Путаницы не будет, потому что каждый формат имеет своё название:

- `ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ID_IOS` — полноэкранный между действиями
- `ADMOB_BANNER_ID_IOS` — баннер внизу/вверху
- `ADMOB_REWARDED_ID_IOS` — rewarded video
- `ADMOB_REWARDED_INTERSTITIAL_ID_IOS` — тот самый beta-формат

Это стандартные термины AdMob/Google — именно так они называются в документации и примерах. Текущие названия оставь как есть.

import 'package:nostr_notes/app/di/auth/auth_di_scope.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/app/di/unauth/db_module.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/services/outbox_publisher.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import 'unauth/unauth_di_scope.dart';

abstract interface class Di {
  static Di? _instance;
  static void overrideDi(Di di) => _instance = di;
  static Di get instance => _instance ??= const AppDi();

  Future<void> bindUnauthModules();
  Future<void> bindAuthModules();

  void removeUnauthModules();
  void removeAuthModules();
}

final class AppDi implements Di {
  const AppDi();

  @override
  Future<void> bindUnauthModules() async {
    final di = DiStorage.shared;

    di.removeScope<UnauthDiScope>();
    di.removeScope<DbModule>();
    di.removeScope<CryptoDiModule>();

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    UnauthDiScope(prefs: prefs).bind(di);
    const DbModule().bind(di);

    await const CryptoDiModule().bind(di);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> bindAuthModules({
    void Function(DiStorage)? testOverrides,
  }) async {
    final di = DiStorage.shared;

    di.removeScope<AuthDiScope>();
    // di.removeScope<ClassificationDi>();

    const AuthDiScope().bind(di);
    testOverrides?.call(di);
    final outbox = di.tryResolve<OutboxPublisher>();
    await outbox?.init();
    // const ClassificationDi().bind(di);
  }

  @override
  void removeAuthModules() {
    final di = DiStorage.shared;
    di.removeScope<AuthDiScope>();
  }

  @override
  void removeUnauthModules() {
    final di = DiStorage.shared;
    di.removeScope<UnauthDiScope>();
    di.removeScope<DbModule>();
    di.removeScope<CryptoDiModule>();
  }
}
```

import 'dart:developer';

import 'package:google_mobile_ads/google_mobile_ads.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/app/app_config.dart';

import 'ads_service.dart';

final class AdsServiceIos implements AdsService {
  InterstitialAd? _ad;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  Future<void> initialize() async {
    await MobileAds.instance.initialize();
    _load();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> showInterstitial() async {
    final ad = _ad;
    if (ad == null) {
      log('Interstitial not ready', name: 'AdsService');
      return;
    }
    ad.fullScreenContentCallback = FullScreenContentCallback(
      onAdDismissedFullScreenContent: (ad) {
        ad.dispose();
        _ad = null;
        _load();
      },
      onAdFailedToShowFullScreenContent: (ad, error) {
        log('Failed to show interstitial: $error', name: 'AdsService');
        ad.dispose();
        _ad = null;
        _load();
      },
    );
    await ad.show();
  }

  void _load() {
    if (_isLoading) return;
    _isLoading = true;
    InterstitialAd.load(
      adUnitId: AppConfig.admobInterstitialIdIos,
      request: const AdRequest(),
      adLoadCallback: InterstitialAdLoadCallback(
        onAdLoaded: (ad) {
          _ad = ad;
          _isLoading = false;
          log('Interstitial loaded', name: 'AdsService');
        },
        onAdFailedToLoad: (error) {
          _isLoading = false;
          log('Failed to load interstitial: $error', name: 'AdsService');
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-12 09:18:41Z)**_

Нет, это не Flutter build hook. Это стандартный механизм VSCode.

**Что я сделал:**

**`.vscode/tasks.json`** — файл задач VSCode. Задача это просто shell-команда с именем.

**`preLaunchTask`** в `launch.json` — говорит VSCode: "перед тем как запустить этот launch-конфиг, выполни задачу с таким именем". Это встроенная функция VSCode, никакого отношения к Flutter не имеет.

**Порядок выполнения при F5:**
```
F5 нажата
  → VSCode находит "Notes (debug)" конфиг
  → видит preLaunchTask: "iOS: resolve SPM packages"
  → запускает tasks.json → ждёт завершения
      → fvm flutter pub get       (генерирует ephemeral/FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage)
      → xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies  (скачивает GoogleMobileAds SPM)
  → только после успеха task — запускает Flutter debug session
```

**Почему именно так:**

`xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies` нужно запускать с тем же состоянием `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage`, которое будет при сборке. Иначе Xcode создаёт другую папку в DerivedData (ключ — хеш от содержимого workspace), и кеш SPM не переиспользуется.

`flutter pub get` перед xcodebuild гарантирует что ephemeral актуален → при сборке Xcode найдёт тот же DerivedData → SPM уже resolved → не нужно скачивать заново.

Here's the situation:

**The SPM error is gone** — your debug output ends at "Launching lib/main.dart on iPhone 13 mini in debug mode..." without the old "Couldn't get the list of tags" error. The fix worked.

**Why the app didn't appear**: the first iOS build after SPM resolution compiles all Swift/ObjC code from scratch, including the Google Mobile Ads SDK (~10 MB framework). This typically takes **5–15 minutes**. Press F5 again and wait — you should see Xcode build progress in the debug console, then the app will appear on the simulator. Subsequent F5 presses will be fast (incremental builds).

**What I fixed now**:
- Removed CocoaPods `#include` lines from `macos/Flutter/Flutter-Debug.xcconfig` and `Flutter-Release.xcconfig` — these were causing the macOS CocoaPods warning
- Changed the pre-launch task back to `reveal: "silent"` so it runs invisibly in the background; it only shows the terminal if it fails

The iOS CocoaPods warning (`Flutter.podspec`) is a false positive — Flutter generates that file but your xcconfig and project files are clean. It's a cosmetic warning only and doesn't affect the build.

Here's the complete explanation of what was wrong and what's fixed:

**Root cause**: Flutter always passes `-clonedSourcePackagesDirPath packages/notes/build/ios/SourcePackages` to xcodebuild when building. That directory had a `workspace-state.json` that was corrupted — it pointed to the `chat` package's FlutterFramework instead of `notes`, and was missing all the local plugin dependencies. When xcodebuild compared the actual `Package.swift` (which lists 10+ dependencies) against this stale state file, it determined everything needed re-resolution. That's when it tried to `git ls-remote` on GitHub and failed.

**The fix**:
1. Added `-clonedSourcePackagesDirPath ${workspaceFolder}/packages/notes/build/ios/SourcePackages` to the preLaunchTask — now both the preLaunchTask and Flutter F5 use the **same SourcePackages directory**
2. Deleted the corrupted `workspace-state.json`

**What happens now**:
- Press F5 → preLaunchTask runs xcodebuild with the correct SourcePackages path → finds the cached checkouts (`swift-package-manager-google-mobile-ads` and artifacts) and the pinned `Package.resolved` → writes a correct `workspace-state.json` → Flutter F5 reads that same file → all packages already resolved → no GitHub fetch needed → build proceeds

The preLaunchTask runs with your terminal/shell environment (where git works), so the one-time resolution succeeds. Every subsequent F5 finds packages already resolved and runs fast.

То есть Xcode хранит resolved packages **не** в стандартном `~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData`, а в `packages/notes/build/ios/SourcePackages/`.

**2. Этот файл был испорчен**

В `build/ios/SourcePackages/workspace-state.json` содержался указатель на `FlutterFramework` из проекта **`chat`** вместо **`notes`**:
```json

```

А также там отсутствовали все локальные плагины (connectivity_plus, file_picker и т.д.).

**3. Как xcodebuild реагировал на это**

Когда Xcode сравнивал `Package.swift` (который ссылается на 10+ пакетов) с этим неверным `workspace-state.json`, он делал вывод: «state устарел, нужно пересобрать». Добавил тот же самый `-clonedSourcePackagesDirPath` в `preLaunchTask`, чтобы задача перед запуском F5 записывала **корректный** `workspace-state.json` в то же место, которое использует Flutter F5. 36	      },

6	
7	final class BlurScreenUsecase {
8	  static const validDuration = Duration(seconds: 180);
9	  final AuthUsecase _authUsecase;
10	  late final BehaviorSubject<BlurScreenState> _stateSubject =
11	      BehaviorSubject.seeded(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
12	  final Now _now;
13	  DateTime? _backgroundEnterTime;
14	
15	  bool _isInBackground = false;
16	
17	  bool _isDisposed = false;
18	
19	  BlurScreenUsecase({required AuthUsecase authUsecase, Now now = const Now()})
20	    : _authUsecase = authUsecase,
21	      _now = now;
22	
23	  Stream<BlurScreenState> get stateStream =>
24	      _stateSubject.stream.distinct().asyncMap((e) {
25	        switch (e) {
26	          case BlurScreenState.blured:
27	            return Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1), () => e);
28	          case BlurScreenState.locked:
29	            return e;
30	          case BlurScreenState.unlocked:
31	            return e;
32	        }
33	      });
34	
35	  BlurScreenState get currentState => _stateSubject.value;
36	
37	  Future<void> onForeground() async {
38	    final isValid =
39	        _backgroundEnterTime != null &&
40	        _now.now().difference(_backgroundEnterTime!) < validDuration;
41	
42	    if (!isValid) {
43	      _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.locked);
44	      await _authUsecase.restore();
45	    } else {
46	      _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
47	    }
48	  }
49	
50	  void onBackground() {
51	    debugPrint('onBackground called at ${_now.now()}');
52	    debugPrint('Current state: ${_stateSubject.value}');
53	
54	    if (_stateSubject.value != BlurScreenState.unlocked) {
55	      debugPrint('State is not unlocked, skipping');
56	      return;
57	    }
58	
59	    _isInBackground = true;
60	    _backgroundEnterTime = _now.now();
61	    if (_isInBackground && _stateSubject.value == BlurScreenState.unlocked) {
62	      debugPrint('Setting state to blured');
63	      _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.blured);
64	    }
65	  }
66	
67	  Future<void> dispose() async {
68	    if (_isDisposed) {
69	      return;
70	    }
71	    _isDisposed = true;
72	
73	    await _stateSubject.close();
74	  }
75	}
76	
77	enum BlurScreenState { blured, locked, unlocked }
78
```

Когда `ad.show()` вызывается в `AdsServiceIos`, Google Mobile Ads SDK презентует новый `UIViewController` поверх Flutter root view controller. iOS при этом вызывает `applicationWillResignActive` → `applicationDidEnterBackground` на app delegate, потому что Flutter view controller теряет фокус.

Flutter транслирует это в `AppLifecycleState.paused` (background), что и вызывает `BlurScreenUsecase.onBackground()` — отсюда и появляется blur.

Последовательность без фикса:
1. `ad.show()` → iOS говорит "app ушёл в background" → `onBackground()` → state = `blured`
2. Реклама закрылась → iOS: "app вернулся" → `onForeground()` → время в пределах `validDuration` → state = `unlocked`

Но даже при быстром возврате пользователь видит blur из-за 1-секундной задержки в `stateStream`:

```dart
case BlurScreenState.blured:
  return Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1), () => e);
```

`asyncMap` обрабатывает события последовательно — `unlocked` встаёт в очередь за `blured` и ждёт пока пройдёт 1 секунда. Итог: 1 секунда blur даже если `onForeground()` сработал мгновенно.

Фикс с `_adsService?.isShowingAd == true` в `onBackground()` обрывает эту цепочку — если реклама показывается, `blured` вообще не добавляется в subject, и blur не появляется.

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show debugPrint;
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/usecase/auth_usecase.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/core/tools/now.dart';
import 'package:rxdart/rxdart.dart';

final class BlurScreenUsecase {
  static const _noblurDuration = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const validDuration = Duration(seconds: 180);

  final AuthUsecase _authUsecase;
  late final BehaviorSubject<BlurScreenState> _stateSubject =
      BehaviorSubject.seeded(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
  final Now _now;
  DateTime? _backgroundEnterTime;

  bool _isInBackground = false;
  bool _suppressNextBlur = false;
  bool _isDisposed = false;

  BlurScreenUsecase({required AuthUsecase authUsecase, Now now = const Now()})
    : _authUsecase = authUsecase,
      _now = now;

  /// Call before triggering an action that causes the app to briefly go
  /// to background (e.g. showing a fullscreen ad). The next blur transition
  /// will be skipped and the screen will remain unlocked.
  void suppressNextBackground() {
    _suppressNextBlur = true;
  }

  Stream<BlurScreenState> get stateStream =>
      _stateSubject.stream.distinct().switchMap(_mapState);

  Stream<BlurScreenState> _mapState(BlurScreenState e) {
    if (e == BlurScreenState.blured) {
      if (_suppressNextBlur) {
        _suppressNextBlur = false;
        return Stream.value(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
      }
      // Delay gives onForeground() time to cancel it via switchMap when the
      // user returns quickly (<_noblurDuration). If they do, switchMap drops
      // this future and emits unlocked immediately — no blur shown at all.
      return Stream.fromFuture(
        Future.delayed(_noblurDuration, () => e),
      );
    }
    return Stream.value(e);
  }

  BlurScreenState get currentState => _stateSubject.value;

  Future<void> onForeground() async {
    final isValid =
        _backgroundEnterTime != null &&
        _now.now().difference(_backgroundEnterTime!) < validDuration;

    if (!isValid) {
      _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.locked);
      await _authUsecase.restore();
    } else {
      _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
    }
  }

  void onBackground() {
    debugPrint('onBackground called at ${_now.now()}');
    debugPrint('Current state: ${_stateSubject.value}');

    if (_stateSubject.value != BlurScreenState.unlocked) {
      debugPrint('State is not unlocked, skipping');
      return;
    }

    _isInBackground = true;
    _backgroundEnterTime = _now.now();
    debugPrint('Setting state to blured');
    _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.blured);
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    _isDisposed = true;
    await _stateSubject.close();
  }
}

enum BlurScreenState { blured, locked, unlocked }

```

final class BlurScreenUsecase {

  final AuthUsecase _authUsecase;
  late final BehaviorSubject<BlurScreenState> _stateSubject =
      BehaviorSubject.seeded(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
  final Now _now;
  DateTime? _backgroundEnterTime;

  bool _isInBackground = false;
  bool _suppressNextBlur = false;
  bool _isDisposed = false;

  BlurScreenUsecase({required AuthUsecase authUsecase, Now now = const Now()})
    : _authUsecase = authUsecase,
      _now = now;

  /// Call before triggering an action that causes the app to briefly go to
  /// background (e.g. showing a fullscreen ad). The next blur is skipped and
  /// the screen stays unlocked.
  void suppressNextBackground() {
    _suppressNextBlur = true;
  }

  Stream<BlurScreenState> get stateStream =>
      _stateSubject.stream.distinct().switchMap(_mapState);

  Stream<BlurScreenState> _mapState(BlurScreenState e) {
    if (e == BlurScreenState.blured) {
      if (_suppressNextBlur) {
        _suppressNextBlur = false;
        return Stream.value(BlurScreenState.unlocked);

      // switchMap cancels this future when onForeground() emits unlocked —
      // so if the user returns in <_noblurDuration, blur is never shown.
      return Stream.fromFuture(
        Future.delayed(_noblurDuration, () => e),
      );
    }

  }

  BlurScreenState get currentState => _stateSubject.value;

  Future<void> onForeground() async {
    final isValid =

    if (!isValid) {

    } else {
      _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.unlocked);
    }

    debugPrint('Current state: ${_stateSubject.value}');

    _backgroundEnterTime = _now.now();
    debugPrint('Setting state to blured');
    _stateSubject.add(BlurScreenState.blured);
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_isDisposed) return;
    _isDisposed = true;
    await _stateSubject.close();

}

enum BlurScreenState { blured, locked, unlocked }

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:mocktail/mocktail.dart';
import 'package:nostr/model/user_keys.dart';
import 'package:common/data/repo/key_tool_repository_impl.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/model/session/session.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/repository/app_lifecycle_listener_repository.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/repository/biometric_repository.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/usecase/auth_usecase.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/usecase/session_usecase.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/common/domain/usecase/verification_usecase.dart';

import 'package:rxdart/rxdart.dart';

import '../tools/mocks/mock_relays_list_repo.dart';
import '../tools/mocks/mock_secure_storage.dart';
import '../tools/some_moked_data.dart';

class MockBiometricRepository extends Mock implements BiometricRepository {}

class MockAppLifecycleListenerRepository
    implements AppLifecycleListenerRepository {
  @override
  late final PublishSubject<bool> isActiveStream = PublishSubject();

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    isActiveStream.close();
  }
}

void main() {
  const maxTimeout = Timeout(Duration(seconds: 10));

  late BiometricRepository biometry;
  late MockAppLifecycleListenerRepository lifecycle;
  late AuthUsecase authUsecase;

  late MockSecureStorage secureStorage;
  late MockRelaysListRepo relaysListRepo;
  late SessionUsecase sessionUsecase;
  late KeyToolRepositoryImpl keyToolRepository;

  late VerificationUsecase sut;

  const allow = Verification.allow();
  const deny = Verification.deny();
  const processing = Verification.processing();
  const biometryRequest = BiometricRepositoryRequest(
    localizedReason: 'Unlock application',
  );

  const unlockedSession = Unlocked(
    keys: UserKeys(
      publicKey: SomeMokedData.publicKey,
      privateKey: SomeMokedData.privateKey,
    ),
    pin: '1234',
  );

  void buildSut({
    Duration maxInactiveDuration =
        VerificationUsecase.defaultMaxInactiveDuration,
    Duration debounceGuard = Duration.zero,
  }) {
    sut = VerificationUsecase(
      biometricRepository: biometry,
      appLifecycleListenerRepository: lifecycle,
      authUsecase: authUsecase,
      maxInactiveDuration: maxInactiveDuration,
      debounceGuard: debounceGuard,
    );
  }

  setUp(() {
    biometry = MockBiometricRepository();
    lifecycle = MockAppLifecycleListenerRepository();

    secureStorage = MockSecureStorage();
    relaysListRepo = MockRelaysListRepo();
    sessionUsecase = SessionUsecase();
    keyToolRepository = const KeyToolRepositoryImpl();

    authUsecase = AuthUsecase(
      secureStorage: secureStorage,
      sessionUsecase: sessionUsecase,
      keyToolRepository: keyToolRepository,
      relaysListRepo: relaysListRepo,
    );
    buildSut();
  });

  tearDown(() async {
    await sut.dispose();
    await sessionUsecase.dispose();
  });

  group('when session is not unlocked (Unauth)', () {
    test('going to background emits Allow', () async {
      final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
      final emitted = <Verification>[];
      final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

      lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
      await pumpEventQueue();

      expect(emitted, [allow]);
      await sub.cancel();
    }, timeout: maxTimeout);
  });

  group('when session is Unlocked', () {
    setUp(() {
      sessionUsecase.setSession(unlockedSession);
    });

    test('going to background emits Deny', () async {
      final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
      final emitted = <Verification>[];
      final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

      lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
      await pumpEventQueue();

      expect(emitted, [isA<Deny>()]);
      await sub.cancel();
    }, timeout: maxTimeout);

    test(
      'returning quickly (within maxInactiveDuration) emits Allow without biometry',
      () async {
        final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
        final emitted = <Verification>[];
        final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
        await pumpEventQueue(); // let background event process first
        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(true);
        await pumpEventQueue();

        expect(emitted, [isA<Deny>(), allow]);
        verifyNever(() => biometry.execute(biometryRequest));
        await sub.cancel();
      },
      timeout: maxTimeout,
    );

    test('duplicate background events are deduplicated', () async {
      final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
      final emitted = <Verification>[];
      final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

      lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
      lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false); // duplicate — filtered by distinct
      await pumpEventQueue();

      expect(emitted, [isA<Deny>()]);
      await sub.cancel();
    }, timeout: maxTimeout);

    test(
      'skipNextVerification prevents blur when going to background',
      () async {
        sut.skipNextVerification();

        final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
        final emitted = <Verification>[];
        final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
        await pumpEventQueue();

        expect(emitted, [allow]);
        await sub.cancel();
      },
      timeout: maxTimeout,
    );

    test(
      'skipNextVerification bypasses biometry on return, no blur shown',
      () async {
        sut.skipNextVerification();

        final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
        final emitted = <Verification>[];
        final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
        await pumpEventQueue();
        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(true);
        await pumpEventQueue();

        expect(emitted, [allow]); // second allow deduplicated by distinct
        verifyNever(() => biometry.execute(biometryRequest));
        await sub.cancel();
      },
      timeout: maxTimeout,
    );
  });

  group('when session is Unlocked and maxInactiveDuration is zero', () {
    setUp(() {
      sessionUsecase.setSession(unlockedSession);
      buildSut(maxInactiveDuration: Duration.zero);
    });

    test(
      'returning after inactivity emits Processing then Allow when biometry succeeds',
      () async {
        when(
          () => biometry.execute(biometryRequest),
        ).thenAnswer((_) async => true);

        final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
        final emitted = <Verification>[];
        final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
        await pumpEventQueue();
        expect(emitted, [deny]);

        // slight delay ensures _deniedAt < DateTime.now() with Duration.zero
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1));

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(true);
        await pumpEventQueue();

        expect(emitted, [deny, processing, allow]);
        await sub.cancel();
      },
      timeout: maxTimeout,
    );

    test(
      'biometry failure emits Deny and restores session to Unauth',
      () async {
        when(
          () => biometry.execute(biometryRequest),
        ).thenAnswer((_) async => false);

        final stream = sut.createStream(biometryRequest: biometryRequest);
        final emitted = <Verification>[];
        final sub = stream.listen(emitted.add);

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(false);
        await pumpEventQueue();
        expect(emitted, [deny]);

        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1));

        lifecycle.isActiveStream.add(true);
        await pumpEventQueue();

        expect(emitted, [deny, processing, allow]);
        // secureStorage is empty → restore() sets Unauth
        expect(sessionUsecase.currentSession, isA<Unauth>());
        await sub.cancel();
      },
      timeout: maxTimeout,
    );
  });
}

    }) : _authUsecase = authUsecase;

    Stream<Verification> createStream({
      required BiometricRepositoryRequest biometryRequest,
    }) {
      return appLifecycleListenerRepository.isActiveStream
          .distinct()
          .switchMap(
            (isActive) => _skipNextVerification
                ? Stream.value(isActive)
                : TimerStream(isActive, debounceGuard),
          )
          .asyncExpand((isActive) {
            _isActive = isActive;
            if (!isActive) {
              setDeniedAtIfNeeded();
              // Skip blur for controlled background (e.g. ad)
              if (_skipNextVerification) {
                return Stream.value(const Verification.allow());
              }
            }

            final isLocked = !_authUsecase.currentSession.isUnlocked;
            if (isLocked) {
              return Stream.value(const Verification.allow());
            }

            return _performAuthorizationIfNeeded(
              isActive: isActive,
              biometryRequest: biometryRequest,
            ).map((value) {
              final isLocked = !_authUsecase.currentSession.isUnlocked;
              if (isLocked) return const Verification.allow();
              if (value == const Verification.deny()) return const Verification.deny();
              return _isActive ? value : const Verification.deny();
            });
          })
          .distinct();
    }

    Stream<Verification> _performAuthorizationIfNeeded({...}) async* {
      final denyTime = _deniedAt;
      if (isActive && denyTime != null) {
        final skip = _skipNextVerification;
        _skipNextVerification = false;
        if (skip || !_isOutdated(denyTime: denyTime)) {
          resetDenyTime();
          yield const Verification.allow();
        } else {
          yield const Verification.processing();
          final status = await _passBiometry(biometricRequest: biometryRequest);
          yield status;
        }
      } else {
        yield const Verification.deny();
      }
    }
  }
  ```

25	  static const archivedFileName = 'notes_export.json';
26	  final RawEventStore _eventStore;
27	  final NoteCryptoUseCase _noteCryptoUseCase;
28	
29	  const ExportUsecaseImpl({
30	    required RawEventStore eventStore,
31	    required NoteCryptoUseCase noteCryptoUseCase,
32	  }) : _eventStore = eventStore,
33	       _noteCryptoUseCase = noteCryptoUseCase;
34	
35	  @override
36	  Future<(String, Uint8List, String)> exportNotes({
37	    // TODO: replace with `ExportParams`
38	    required String password,
39	    required String fileUri,
40	
41	
42	  }) async {
43	    try {
44	      final events = await _eventStore.queryEvents(
45	        RawEventQuery(kinds: [EventKind.note.value]),
46	      );
47	
48	      // Nothing stored — surfaced as empty bytes so the caller can show the
49	      // "no notes" message; not an error per se.
50	      if (events.isEmpty) {
51	        return ('', Uint8List(0), '');
52	      }
53	
54	      final notes = NoteMapper.fromNostrEvents(events);
55	      final decryptedNotes = <Note>[];
56	      for (final note in notes) {
57	        try {
58	          final item = await _noteCryptoUseCase.decryptNote(note);
59	          decryptedNotes.add(item);
60	        } catch (e) {
61	          log(e.toString(), name: 'ExportUsecase');
62	          continue;
63	        }
64	      }
65	
66	      if (decryptedNotes.isEmpty) {
67	        return ('', Uint8List(0), '');
68	      }
69	
70	      final BackupPayload payload;
71	      try {
72	        payload = await _createPayload(decryptedNotes, password: password);
73	      } catch (e) {
74	        throw ExportError(
75	          payload: ExportErrorType.encryptionFailed,
76	          parentError: e,
77	        );
78	      }
79	
80	      final fileName = _fileName();
81	      final Uint8List zipBytes;
82	      final String filePath;
83	      try {
84	        zipBytes = _buildZipBytes(payload);
85	        filePath = kIsWeb ? '' : await _writeToTempFile(zipBytes, fileName);
86	      } catch (e) {
87	        throw ExportError(
88	          payload: ExportErrorType.fileWriteFailed,
89	          parentError: e,
90	        );
91	      }
92	
93	      if (zipBytes.isEmpty) {
94	        throw const ExportError(payload: ExportErrorType.fileWriteFailed);
95	      }
96	
97	      return (filePath, zipBytes, fileName);
98	    } on ExportError {
99	      rethrow;
100	    } catch (e) {
101	      throw ExportError(payload: ExportErrorType.unknown, parentError: e);
102	    }
103	  }
104	
105	  Future<BackupPayload> _createPayload(
106	    List<Note> notes, {
107	    required String password,
108	  }) async {
109	    if (password.isEmpty) {
110	      final exportEvents = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
111	      for (final note in notes) {
112	        exportEvents.add(NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(note).toJson());
113	      }
114	      return BackupPayload(version: 1, encrypted: false, events: exportEvents);
115	    } else {
116	      final salt = _generateRandomBytes(16);
117	      final secretKey = await ExportHelper.deriveKey(
118	        password,
119	        salt,
120	        _kPbkdf2Iterations,
121	      );
122	      final algorithm = AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256());
123	      final exportEvents = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
124	
125	      for (final note in notes) {
126	        exportEvents.add(
127	          NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(
128	            note.copyWith(
129	              content: await _encryptField(note.content, secretKey, algorithm),
130	              summary: await _encryptField(note.summary, secretKey, algorithm),
131	              labels: await _encryptLabels(note.labels, secretKey, algorithm),
132	            ),
133	          ).toJson(),
134	        );
135	      }
136	
137	      return BackupPayload(
138	        version: 1,
139	        encrypted: true,
140	        salt: HexToBytes.bytesToHex(salt),
141	        iterations: _kPbkdf2Iterations,
142	        events: exportEvents,
143	      );
144	    }
145	  }
146	
147	  Uint8List _buildZipBytes(BackupPayload payload) {
148	    final jsonBytes = utf8.encode(
149	      const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert(payload.toJson()),
150	    );
151	    final archive = Archive()
152	      ..addFile(ArchiveFile(archivedFileName, jsonBytes.length, jsonBytes));
153	    return Uint8List.fromList(ZipEncoder().encode(archive));
154	  }
155	
156	  Future<String> _writeToTempFile(Uint8List bytes, String fileName) async {
157	    final file = File('${(await getTemporaryDirectory()).path}/$fileName');
158	    await file.writeAsBytes(bytes);
159	    return file.path;
160	  }
161	
162	  String _fileName() {
163	    const filePrefix = 'notes_backup_';
164	    final timestamp = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().replaceAll(':', '-');
165	    return '$filePrefix$timestamp.zip';
166	  }
167	
168	  Future<String> _encryptField(
169	    String text,
170	    SecretKey key,
171	    AesCbc algorithm,
172	  ) async {
173	    if (text.isEmpty) return '';
174	    final iv = _generateRandomBytes(16);
175	    final secretBox = await algorithm.encrypt(
176	      utf8.encode(text),
177	      secretKey: key,
178	      nonce: iv,
179	    );
180	    return '${base64Encode(secretBox.cipherText)}?iv=${base64Encode(iv)}&mac=${base64Encode(secretBox.mac.bytes)}';
181	  }
182	
183	  Future<List<BaseLabel>> _encryptLabels(
184	    List<BaseLabel> labels,
185	    SecretKey key,
186	    AesCbc algorithm,
187	  ) async {
188	    if (labels.isEmpty) return const [];
189	    final joined = BaseLabel.joinLabels(labels.whereType<Label>());
190	    if (joined.isEmpty) return const [];
191	    final encrypted = await _encryptField(joined, key, algorithm);
192	    return [EncryptedLabel(textValue: encrypted)];
193	  }
194	
195	  Uint8List _generateRandomBytes(int length) {
196	    final random = math.Random.secure();
197	    return Uint8List.fromList(
198	      List.generate(length, (_) => random.nextInt(256)),
199	    );
200	  }
201	}
202	
203	abstract interface class ExportHelper {
204	  static Future<SecretKey> deriveKey(
205	    String password,
206	    Uint8List salt,
207	    int iterations,
208	  ) {
209	    return Pbkdf2(
210	      macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256(),
211	      iterations: iterations,
212	      bits: 256,
213	    ).deriveKeyFromPassword(password: password, nonce: salt);
214	  }
215	}
216

35	abstract interface class ExportUsecase {
36	  /// Returns `(filePath, zipBytes, fileName)`.
37	  /// On web [filePath] is empty; callers must use [zipBytes] + [fileName] instead.
38	  Future<(String, Uint8List, String)> exportNotes({

40	    required String fileUri,

45	  const ExportError({required super.payload, super.parentError, super.reason});
46	}
47	
48	enum ExportErrorType {
49	  /// There is nothing to export (empty store or no decryptable notes).
50	  noNotes,
51	
52	  /// Password-based encryption of the backup failed.
53	  encryptionFailed,
54	
55	  /// Writing/zipping the backup file failed.
56	  fileWriteFailed,
57	
58	  /// Any other, unanticipated failure.
59	  unknown,

import 'package:common/app/theme/sizes.dart';
import 'package:common/l10n/localization.dart';
import 'package:common/presentation/dialogs/common_tooltip.dart';
import 'package:common/presentation/dialogs/dialog_button.dart';
import 'package:common/presentation/widgets/onboarding_text_field.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:nostr_notes/l10n/localization.dart';

/// Password dialog for export. Pops with the entered password string,
/// or `null` if the user cancelled. An empty string means no password.
final class ExportPasswordDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ExportPasswordDialog({super.key});

  @override
  State<ExportPasswordDialog> createState() => _ExportPasswordDialogState();
}

final class _ExportPasswordDialogState extends State<ExportPasswordDialog> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>(debugLabel: '_ExportPasswordDialogState');
  late final _controller = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    final commonL10n = context.commonL10n;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return AppAlertDialog(
      title: Text(l10n.exportImportPasswordDialogTitle),
      content: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            OnboardingTextFormField(
              controller: _controller,
              obscureText: true,
              hint: l10n.exportImportPasswordDialogTextFieldHint,
              inputFormatters: [
                FilteringTextInputFormatter.deny(RegExp(r'\s')),
              ],
              validator: _validate,
            ),
            CommonTooltip(
              title: commonL10n.commonWarning,
              message: l10n.exportImportNoPasswordWarning,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(Sizes.indent2x),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: Sizes.indent),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.info_outline,
                      size: Sizes.iconSmall,
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: Sizes.indent),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        l10n.exportImportPasswordDialogHint,
                        style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        DialogTextButtonUnderlined(
          text: commonL10n.commonButtonCancel,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        DialogTextButton(
          text: commonL10n.commonButtonOk,
          onPressed: _onConfirm,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _onConfirm() {
    if (_formKey.currentState?.validate() ?? false) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop(_controller.text.trim());
    }
  }

  String? _validate(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return null;
    const minPasswordLength = 3;
    if (value.length < minPasswordLength) {
      return context.l10n.exportImportPasswordTooShort(
        minPasswordLength.toString(),
      );
    }
    return null;
  }
}

```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The user is asking about the difference between `clearMaterialBanners` and `clearSnackBars` in Flutter's `ScaffoldMessenger`.

`clearMaterialBanners()` — removes all currently displayed and queued Material banners (the persistent banners shown at the top of a Scaffold with `ScaffoldMessenger.showMaterialBanner()`).

`clearSnackBars()` — removes all currently displayed and queued SnackBars (the temporary bottom notifications shown with `ScaffoldMessenger.showSnackBar()`).
The key difference is that SnackBars are temporary notifications that auto-dismiss after a set duration, while MaterialBanners are persistent and stay visible until the user dismisses them or you clear them programmatically. In their code on line 203 of `settings_screen_item.dart`, they're using `clearSnackBars` to remove those temporary bottom notifications.
</details></think>

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-06-12 19:48:40Z)**_

Это два разных типа UI-уведомлений в Flutter:

**`clearSnackBars()`** — очищает очередь `SnackBar`: временные сообщения внизу экрана, которые автоматически исчезают через таймаут.

**`clearMaterialBanners()`** — очищает очередь `MaterialBanner`: персистентные баннеры сразу под AppBar, которые **не** исчезают сами — требуют либо явного действия пользователя (кнопки), либо программного `hideCurrentMaterialBanner()` / `clearMaterialBanners()`.

На практике если в коде используется только `showSnackBar` — нужен `clearSnackBars`. Если `showMaterialBanner` — `clearMaterialBanners`. Вызов не того метода просто ничего не делает (очередь другого типа не затрагивается).

59	    final session = _sessionUsecase.currentSession;

61	    final privateKey = session.keys?.privateKey;
62	    if (privateKey == null || privateKey.isEmpty) {
63	      throw const ImportError(payload: ImportErrorType.notAuthenticated);

66	    // 1) Decrypt every incoming note to plaintext (content/summary/labels).
67	    //    A failure here (key derivation or AES) means a wrong password or a
68	    //    corrupted backup.

70	    try {
71	      final algData = await _prepareAlgDataIfNeeded(payload, password);

76	          continue;
77	        }
78	
79	        final content = await _decryptFieldIfNeeded(note.content, algData);
80	        final summary = await _decryptFieldIfNeeded(note.summary, algData);
81	        final labels = await _decryptLabelsIfNeeded(note.labels, algData);
82	
83	        plainNotes.add(

103	        final existing = existingByDTag[incoming.dTag];
104	        final resolved = policy.apply(incoming, existing);

128	    late final Uint8List bytes;

130	      bytes = fileBytes;
131	    } else {

144	      }
145

162	  /// Loads and decrypts the stored notes whose d-tag matches any incoming one,
163	  /// keyed by d-tag. Only notes authored by [pubkey] are considered.
164	  Future<Map<String, Note>> _loadExistingByDTag(
165	    List<Note> incoming,
166	    String pubkey,
167	  ) async {
168	    final dTags = incoming
169	        .map((n) => n.dTag)
170	        .where((d) => d.isNotEmpty)
171	        .toList();
172	    if (dTags.isEmpty) {
173	      return const {};
174	    }
175	
176	    final events = await _eventStore.queryEvents(
177	      RawEventQuery(
178	        kinds: [EventKind.note.value],
179	        authors: [pubkey],
180	        tagFilters: [TagFilter(Tag.d.value, dTags)],
181	      ),
182	    );
183	
184	    final result = <String, Note>{};
185	    for (final event in events) {

187	      if (note == null) continue;

189	    }
190	    return result;

193	  /// The summary is derived from content, so it must be regenerated whenever a
194	  /// policy rewrote the content (MergeContent). keepIncoming/keepExisting leave
195	  /// content untouched and thus keep their already-correct summary.
196	  Note _withFreshSummary(Note resolved, Note incoming, Note? existing) {
197	    final contentChanged =
198	        resolved.content != incoming.content &&
199	        resolved.content != existing?.content;
200	    if (!contentChanged) {
201	      return resolved;
202	    }
203	    return resolved.copyWith(summary: CrerateSummaryHelper.create(resolved));
204	  }

206	  FutureOr<_AlgData?> _prepareAlgDataIfNeeded(
207	    BackupPayload payload,
208	    String password,
209	  ) async {
210	    if (!payload.encrypted) {
211	      return null;
212	    }
213	
214	    final salt = HexToBytes.hexToBytes(payload.salt!);
215	    final iterations = payload.iterations ?? _kPbkdf2Iterations;
216	    final secretKey = await ExportHelper.deriveKey(password, salt, iterations);
217	    final algorithm = AesCbc.with256bits(macAlgorithm: Hmac.sha256());
218	    return _AlgData(secretKey, algorithm);
219	  }
220	
221	  /// Re-encrypts [note] under the current account and produces a properly
222	  /// signed event (correct id + sig), reusing the note's d-tag.
223	  ///
224	  /// Date handling follows the Nostr/app conventions:
225	  /// - `created_at` is the publication timestamp and is refreshed to `now` on
226	  ///   every (re)publish — it feeds the event id/sig, and the store resolves
227	  ///   replaceable-event conflicts by it, so the result always supersedes the
228	  ///   stored version sharing the d-tag.
229	  /// - `init_at` (the `updated_at` tag) is carried over unchanged; an import is
230	  ///   not a user content edit.
231	  Future<NostrEvent> _buildSignedEvent({
232	    required Note note,
233	    required String pubkey,
234	    required String privateKey,
235	  }) async {
236	    final createdAt = _now.now();
237	
238	    // Refresh created_at; keep the original init_at (note.updatedAt).
239	    final preparedNote = note.copyWith(createdAt: createdAt);
240	
241	    final reEncrypted = await _noteCryptoUseCase.encryptNote(preparedNote);
242	    final tags = NoteMapper.toNostrEvent(reEncrypted, pubkey: pubkey).tags;
243	
244	    return _eventCreator.createEvent(
245	      kind: EventKind.note.value,
246	      content: reEncrypted.content,
247	      createdAt: createdAt,
248	      tags: tags,
249	      pubkey: pubkey,
250	      privateKey: privateKey,
251	    );
252	  }

254	  FutureOr<String> _decryptFieldIfNeeded(String encoded, _AlgData? algData) {
255	    return algData == null ? encoded : _decryptField(encoded, algData);
256	  }
257	
258	  Future<String> _decryptField(String encoded, _AlgData algData) async {
259	    if (encoded.isEmpty) return '';
260	    final parts = encoded.split('?iv=');
261	    final cipherText = base64Decode(parts[0]);
262	    final ivAndMac = parts[1].split('&mac=');
263	    final iv = base64Decode(ivAndMac[0]);
264	    final mac = Mac(base64Decode(ivAndMac[1]));
265	    final plainBytes = await algData.algorithm.decrypt(
266	      SecretBox(cipherText, nonce: iv, mac: mac),
267	      secretKey: algData.secretKey,
268	    );
269	    return utf8.decode(plainBytes);
270	  }
271	
272	  FutureOr<List<BaseLabel>> _decryptLabelsIfNeeded(
273	    List<BaseLabel> labels,
274	    _AlgData? algData,
275	  ) {
276	    return algData == null ? labels : _decryptLabels(labels, algData);
277	  }
278	
279	  Future<List<BaseLabel>> _decryptLabels(
280	    List<BaseLabel> labels,
281	    _AlgData algData,
282	  ) async {
283	    if (labels.isEmpty) return const [];
284	    final decrypted = await _decryptField(labels.first.textValue, algData);
285	    if (decrypted.isEmpty) return const [];
286	    return BaseLabel.fromJoinedText(decrypted);
287	  }
288	}

The error is "Null check operator used on a null value" when opening the Settings/Preferences screen. This would be caused by some widget in the Settings screen calling `context.commonL10n` (which uses `CommonL10n.of(this)!`).

The fix is to add Bulgarian support to the `common` package. I need to:
1. Create the Bulgarian ARB file for the common package by copying the English version as a starting point

# Private Notes (Nostr) — Monorepo

End-to-end encrypted notes app built on the [Nostr](https://nostr.com) protocol. Notes are encrypted on-device with NIP-44, signed with secp256k1, and stored on user-selected relays. No server, no accounts — only a keypair.

**Platforms:** iOS · Android · macOS · Web

---

## Packages

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`packages/notes`](packages/notes/) | Main app — the production Notes application |
| [`packages/common`](packages/common/) | Shared UI components, theme, database (drift), l10n utilities |
| [`packages/nostr`](packages/nostr/) | Pure Nostr protocol library — client, relay, event models, NIPs |
| [`packages/chat`](packages/chat/) | ⚠️ Draft — Nostr-based chat app. Currently in early draft state; further development is uncertain |

## Native crypto module

`cpp/ffi/` contains a native secp256k1 crypto module (CMake). Built as an `.xcframework` for iOS/macOS and `.so` for Android. Consumed via `CryptoService` in `packages/notes`.

---

## Requirements

- **Flutter:** 3.44.0 (managed via [FVM](https://fvm.app) — use `fvm flutter` or activate the version globally)
- **Melos:** for workspace dependency management and scripts
- **Ruby / Bundler:** only required for relay management (`make relay_up`)

---

## Quick start

\```bash
# Install workspace dependencies
make bootstrap       # runs: melos bootstrap

# Run all tests with coverage
make test

# Regenerate l10n after editing .arb files
make l10n

# Regenerate JSON serialization (.g.dart)
make codegen

# Build release APK
make build_apk
\```

### Native FFI (secp256k1)

\```bash
make ffi-ios      # builds crypto_module.xcframework for iOS
make ffi-macos    # builds crypto_module.xcframework for macOS
\```

### Local relay (for integration tests)

\```bash
make relay_up     # starts relay in Docker via Fastlane
make relay_down
make relay_clean
\```

---

## Repository layout

\```
packages/
  notes/          ← Main Flutter app
  common/         ← Shared package (no app entry point)
  nostr/          ← Protocol library (no UI)
  chat/           ← Draft app
cpp/
  ffi/            ← secp256k1 native module (CMake)
  secp256k1/      ← secp256k1 C library source
Makefile          ← All common commands
melos.yaml        ← Workspace config
\```

```

# packages/notes — Private Notes App

Main Flutter application. Entry point: `lib/main.dart`.

**Platforms:** iOS · Android · macOS · Web

---

## Architecture

Clean Architecture layers inside `lib/`:

\```
app/              ← DI setup (Di/AppDi), go_router config, AppConfig
auth/
  domain/         ← Models (Note, Label), Usecase/Repository interfaces
  data/           ← Usecase/Repository implementations, mappers
  presentation/   ← Screens, Blocs, Vm (ViewModels)
common/           ← Cross-feature shared domain/presentation within the app
services/         ← CryptoService (FFI), OutboxPublisher, background workers
core/             ← NostrKind constants, low-level tools
unauth/           ← Pre-login screens (onboarding)
\```

**State management**
- `flutter_bloc` (`Bloc`) for screen-level state. State classes carry a `data` field; sealed subclasses represent transitions (`LoadingState`, `ErrorState`, `CommonState`).
- Custom `Vm extends ValueNotifier` for lightweight reactive state (e.g., `PendingVm`).

**DI** — `di_storage` (`DiStorage.shared`), not `get_it`.
- `Di.instance.bindUnauthModules()` — called at startup.
- `Di.instance.bindAuthModules()` — called when session is authenticated.
- Scopes are removed on logout.

**Routing** — `go_router`. Never call `GoRouter.of(context)` from UI; use `RouteHandler.of(context)?.onRoute(SomeRoute(), context)` instead.

**Nostr specifics**
- Event kinds via `NostrKind` constants. Notes are kind `30023` (NIP-33).
- Zaps follow NIP-57: always include `p`, `P`, `description` and `client` tags.
- `OutboxPublisher` handles async relay publishing with outbox queue persistence.

---

## Running & building

\```bash
# Get dependencies (from repo root)
make bootstrap

# Run (from this directory)
fvm flutter run

# Build release APK
make build_apk          # from repo root

# Build native FFI (required if crypto module is missing)
make ffi-ios            # iOS xcframework
make ffi-macos          # macOS xcframework
\```

---

## Tests

### Unit & widget tests

\```bash
# All tests
cd packages/notes && fvm flutter test

# Single file
cd packages/notes && fvm flutter test test/auth/domain/create_note_usecase_test.dart

# With coverage (from repo root)
make test
\```

**Widget tests** — wrap in `AppLauncher.launchApp(child: ..., tester: ...)` (see `test/tools/app_launcher/`) to get theme, l10n, and `RootContextProvider`.

**DI in tests** — bind via `DiStorage.shared`; always clean up:
\```dart
tearDown(() => DiStorage.shared.removeAll());
\```

**Async UI** — use `PumpHelpers.waitFor(tester, finder)` instead of manual pump loops. Use `PumpHelpers.pumpFrames` when `pumpAndSettle` would hang due to background streams.

**Mocking** — `Mocktail`. In-memory DB via `InMemoryDbModule` (re-exported from `packages/common/test/tools/di/`).

### Integration tests

> ⚠️ Integration tests in `integration_test/` have degraded over time and are unlikely to run out of the box. They also require a local Nostr relay running in Docker:
> \```bash
> make relay_up   # starts relay via Fastlane + Docker
> \```
> Running them via Fastlane: `bundle exec fastlane integration_test test:registration_test.dart`

---

## Localization

Supported locales: **English**, **Russian**, **Bulgarian**.

ARB files in `lib/l10n/`. After editing, regenerate:
\```bash
make l10n   # from repo root
\```

---

## Clean cache

\```bash
flutter clean && flutter pub get
# or if dart_tool issues:
rm -rf .dart_tool/hooks_runner && flutter pub get
\```

```

# packages/nostr — Nostr Protocol Library

Pure Dart Nostr protocol library. No UI, no app-specific logic. Used by `packages/notes` and `packages/chat`.

---

## Contents

\```
lib/
  model/          ← Event models (NostrEvent, NostrFilter, UserKeys, tags, …)
  nostr_client/   ← NostrClient, NostrRelay, NostrPublisher, relay monitoring
  key_tool/       ← Key derivation and conversion utilities
  hex/            ← Hex encoding/decoding
\```

**Key types**

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `NostrClient` | Manages connections to multiple relays; subscribe/publish |
| `NostrRelay` | Single relay connection (WebSocket, reconnect logic) |
| `NostrEvent` | Signed Nostr event (kind, content, tags, sig) |
| `NostrFilter` / `NostrReq` | Subscription filters (REQ) |
| `UserKeys` | Public/private keypair wrapper |
| `NostrEventCreator` | Builds and signs events |
| `PublishEventReport` | Result of a publish operation per relay |

---

## Codegen

Some models use `json_serializable`. After changing annotated classes:

\```bash
make codegen   # from repo root
\```

```

# packages/common — Shared Package

Shared UI components, theme, database, and localization utilities. No app entry point — consumed by `packages/notes` and `packages/chat`.

---

## Contents

\```
lib/
  app/
    theme/        ← AppTheme, AppBackgroundColors, color schemes
  data/           ← Repository implementations (theme, settings)
  domain/         ← Repository interfaces, GlobalSettingsScope/GlobalSettingsVm
  l10n/           ← CommonLocalizations (en, ru, bg); localization.dart helper
  presentation/
    buttons/      ← Reusable button widgets
    dialogs/      ← AppAlertDialog, DialogHelper mixin, dialog buttons
    widgets/      ← SettingsItemTile, OnboardingTextField, ProgressHud, MarkdownWidget, …
  tools/          ← OptionalBox and other utilities
\```

**Database** — `AppDatabase` (drift/SQLite). Shared schema across apps.

**Theme** — `AppTheme` with light/dark variants. Background colors managed via `AppBackgroundColors`. Users configure theme mode and color scheme via `GlobalSettingsVm`.

**Localization** — `CommonLocalizations` delegate supports `en`, `ru`, `bg`. Use `context.commonL10n` (extension in `localization.dart`).

---

## Localization

ARB files in `lib/l10n/`. After editing, regenerate from repo root:

\```bash
make l10n
\```

---

## Tests

\```bash
cd packages/common && fvm flutter test
\```

Test utilities in `test/tools/di/` are re-exported for use in other packages (e.g., `InMemoryDbModule`).

# packages/chat — Nostr Chat App

> ⚠️ **Draft.** This package is in early draft state. Whether it will be developed further is unknown. Do not depend on its API or structure being stable.

Nostr-based encrypted chat application. Separate entry point from `packages/notes`.

---

## Differences from `packages/notes`

| Aspect | notes | chat |
|--------|-------|------|
| DI | `di_storage` | `get_it` |
| Routing | `go_router` | `auto_route` |
| State | `flutter_bloc` + `Vm` | `flutter_bloc` |

---

## Structure

\```
lib/
  auth/           ← Authenticated features
  common/         ← Shared within chat
  unauth/         ← Onboarding / login
  router/         ← auto_route setup
  main.dart
\```

---

## Known issues

- `build/` directory may be picked up by the Dart analyzer (SPM packages from `google_mobile_ads`). The `analysis_options.yaml` excludes `build/**` to suppress this.
- `riverpod_generator` brings in `mockito 5.7.0` which is incompatible with `analyzer ^10.0.0`. A `dependency_overrides` constraint is set in `pubspec.yaml` to pin `mockito` to `<5.6.5`.

**File:** `/Users/alekseypopkov/Doc/nostr_notes/nostr_notes/packages/common/lib/services/event_store/drift_event_store.dart`

The `DriftEventStore` is a thin wrapper around `NostrEventDao`.

**File:** `/Users/alekseypopkov/Doc/nostr_notes/nostr_notes/packages/common/lib/services/event_store/database/daos/nostr_event_dao.dart` (lines 302-315)

```dart
Stream<List<NostrEvent>> watchEvents(RawEventQuery query) {
  if (query.tagFilters == null || query.tagFilters!.isEmpty) {
    final selectStmt = _buildSimpleSelect(query);
    return selectStmt.watch().map(_mapEventRowsFromEvents);
  } else {
    final joined = _buildJoinedSelect(query);
    return joined.watch().map((rows) {
      final events = _deduplicateEventRowsById(
        rows.map((r) => r.readTable(nostrEvents)).toList(),
      );
      return _mapEventRowsFromEvents(events);
    });
  }
}
```

**Answer:** Yes, `watchEvents()` uses **drift's `.watch()`** method, which is a reactive stream that automatically emits whenever database changes occur. This is a continuous stream, not a one-time query.

### 3. upsert() Implementation

**File:** `/Users/alekseypopkov/Doc/nostr_notes/nostr_notes/packages/common/lib/services/event_store/database/daos/nostr_event_dao.dart` (lines 23-125)

1. **Filters stale replaceable events** - skips events where DB already has a newer version

3. **Performs batch insertions** in a transaction:

   - Inserts events with `InsertMode.insertOrReplace`
   - Deletes all tags for these events, then re-inserts new tags

case DidSaveState():
  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(content: Text(context.l10n.editNoteScreenSaveSuccess)),
  );

  final noteId = pathParams?.id ?? '';
  final isNew = noteId.isEmpty;

  if (isNew) {
    // NEW NOTE: Navigate to NotePreviewRoute with the dTag
    RouteHandler.of(
      context,
    )?.onRoute(NotePreviewRoute(noteId: state.note.dTag), context);
  } else {
    // EXISTING NOTE: Pop the screen
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }
  break;
```

53	        log('Failed to decrypt note ${note.dTag}: $e', stackTrace: s);
54	        decryptedNotes.add(note.copyWith(error: e));
55	      }
56	    }
57	
58	    return decryptedNotes;
59	  }

31	    };

## GetNotesUsecase

**File:** `/Users/alekseypopkov/Doc/nostr_notes/nostr_notes/packages/notes/lib/auth/domain/usecase/get_notes_usecase.dart`

**Return Type:** `Stream<List<Note>>`

**Key Characteristics:**
- **Uses `watchNotes()`** - This is a continuous watch stream (line 32)
- Calls `_notesRepository.watchNotes(pubkey: publicKey)` for streaming watch behavior
- Uses `switchMap()` to handle the stream transformation
- Decrypts notes asynchronously via `_decryptNotes()` 
- Sorts decrypted notes by `updatedAt` in descending order
- Handles decryption errors gracefully by adding notes with error state

**Flow:**
1. Gets public key from session
2. Watches notes from repository
3. For each update, decrypts all notes
4. Sorts by update time and emits

---

## FetchNotesUsecase

**File:** `/Users/alekseypopkov/Doc/nostr_notes/nostr_notes/packages/notes/lib/auth/domain/usecase/fetch_notes_usecase.dart`

**Return Type:** `Stream<List<dynamic>>`

**Key Characteristics:**
- **Returns `eventsStream`** (lines 48, 74) - NOT a watch stream, but an events stream
- Uses pattern matching to handle two parameter types: `UserNotes()` and `NoteWithId()`
- **For `UserNotes` (current user):**
  - Syncs relays first
  - Calls `sendNotesRequest()` to fetch notes from relays
  - Returns `_notesRepository.eventsStream` with error handling
- **For `NoteWithId` (fetch specific note):**
  - Uses `Future.microtask()` to schedule a relay request
  - Calls `sendNoteRequest()` to fetch single note
  - Returns `eventsStream` filtered to only emit events matching the requested note ID
- Has error transformation to convert network errors to `FetchNotesUsecaseNetworkError`
- Exposes `relayErrors` stream from repository

**Key Difference:** Unlike `GetNotesUsecase` which uses `watchNotes()` for continuous watching, `FetchNotesUsecase` uses `eventsStream` which appears to be a one-time or temporary stream of events from relay requests.

23	  Future<void> upsertEvents(Iterable<NostrEvent> events) async {
24	    if (events.isEmpty) return;
25	
26	    await transaction(() async {
27	      final nowMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
28	
29	      // Pre-filter: skip replaceable events where DB already has a newer
30	      // version. This must happen before the batch because batch operations
31	      // cannot perform conditional queries.
32	      final eventsToUpsert = await _filterStaleReplaceableEvents(events);
33	
34	      await batch((b) {
35	        if (eventsToUpsert.isNotEmpty) {
36	          final eventIds = eventsToUpsert.map((e) => e.id).toSet();
37	
38	          // 1) Upsert events in bulk
39	          for (final e in eventsToUpsert) {
40	            /// Delete previous version of replaceable event
41	            ///
42	            if (e.kind >= 10000 && e.kind < 20000 ||
43	                e.kind == 0 ||
44	                e.kind == 3) {
45	              b.deleteWhere(
46	                nostrEvents,
47	                (events) =>
48	                    events.kind.equals(e.kind) & events.pubkey.equals(e.pubkey),
49	              );
50	            } else if (e.kind >= 30000 && e.kind < 40000) {
51	              final dTag = e.getDTag();
52	              if (dTag != null && dTag.isNotEmpty) {
53	                // Addressable events: delete by kind + pubkey + d-tag
54	                final subquery = selectOnly(nostrTags)
55	                  ..addColumns([nostrTags.eventId])
56	                  ..where(
57	                    nostrTags.tag.equals('d') & nostrTags.value.equals(dTag),
58	                  );
59	
60	                b.deleteWhere(
61	                  nostrEvents,
62	                  (events) =>
63	                      events.kind.equals(e.kind) &
64	                      events.pubkey.equals(e.pubkey) &
65	                      events.id.isInQuery(subquery),
66	                );
67	              }
68	            }
69	
70	            b.insert(
71	              nostrEvents,
72	              NostrEventsCompanion(
73	                id: Value(e.id),
74	                kind: Value(e.kind),
75	                pubkey: Value(e.pubkey),
76	                createdAt: Value(e.createdAt),
77	                receivedAt: Value(nowMs),
78	                content: Value(e.content),
79	                sig: Value(e.sig),
80	                tags: Value(jsonEncode(e.tags)),
81	              ),
82	              mode: InsertMode.insertOrReplace,
83	            );
84	          }
85	
86	          // 2) Delete all tags for these events in one go
87	          b.deleteWhere(nostrTags, (t) => t.eventId.isIn(eventIds));
88	
89	          // 3) Insert all tags for all events in one batch
90	          for (final e in eventsToUpsert) {
91	            if (e.tags.isEmpty) continue;
92	
93	            for (final tag in e.tags) {
94	              if (tag.isEmpty) continue;
95	
96	              final tagName = tag[0];
97	              final tagValue = tag.length >= 2 ? tag[1] : '';
98	              final extras = tag.length > 2 ? tag.sublist(2) : [];
99	
100	              b.insert(
101	                nostrTags,
102	                NostrTagsCompanion.insert(
103	                  eventId: e.id,
104	                  tag: tagName,
105	                  value: tagValue,
106	                  extraJson: Value(extras.isEmpty ? null : jsonEncode(extras)),
107	                ),
108	              );
109	            }
110	          }
111	        }
112	
113	        // 4) Record which relay each event came from.
114	        _insertRelayInfo(events, b, nowMs);
115	      });
116	
117	      // 5) Handle kind=5 deletion events (NIP-09):
118	      // delete referenced events by e-tag and a-tag.
119	      for (final delEvent in eventsToUpsert) {
120	        if (delEvent.kind == NostrKind.deletion) {
121	          await _handleDeletionEvent(delEvent);
122	        }
123	      }
124	    });
125	  }

143	  /// NIP-09: handles a deletion event by removing referenced events.
144	  /// - e-tags: delete events by ID (same author only)
145	  /// - a-tags: delete addressable events by kind+pubkey+d-tag
146	  ///   where created_at <= deletion's created_at
147	  /// Must be called inside a transaction.
148	  Future<void> _handleDeletionEvent(NostrEvent delEvent) async {
149	    final delPubkey = delEvent.pubkey;
150	    final delCreatedAtSec = delEvent.createdAt;
151	    final idsToDelete = <String>{};
152	
153	    // 1) e-tags: delete specific events by ID (same author only)
154	    final eTagIds = delEvent.getTagsSet(Tag.e);
155	    if (eTagIds.isNotEmpty) {
156	      final rows =
157	          await (select(nostrEvents)..where(
158	                (e) => e.id.isIn(eTagIds.toList()) & e.pubkey.equals(delPubkey),
159	              ))
160	              .get();
161	      idsToDelete.addAll(rows.map((r) => r.id));
162	    }
163	
164	    // 2) a-tags: delete addressable events by kind+pubkey+d-tag
165	    final aTags = delEvent.getTagsSet(Tag.a);
166	    for (final aTag in aTags) {
167	      final parts = aTag.split(':');
168	      if (parts.length < 3) continue;
169	
170	      final kind = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
171	      final pubkey = parts[1];
172	      final dIdentifier = parts[2];
173	      if (kind == null) continue;
174	      // Only the same author can delete their own events
175	      if (pubkey != delPubkey) continue;
176	
177	      final dTagSubquery = selectOnly(nostrTags)
178	        ..addColumns([nostrTags.eventId])
179	        ..where(
180	          nostrTags.tag.equals(TagValue.d) &
181	              nostrTags.value.equals(dIdentifier),
182	        );
183	
184	      final rows =
185	          await (select(nostrEvents)..where(
186	                (e) =>
187	                    e.kind.equals(kind) &
188	                    e.pubkey.equals(pubkey) &
189	                    e.id.isInQuery(dTagSubquery) &
190	                    e.createdAt.isSmallerOrEqualValue(delCreatedAtSec),
191	              ))
192	              .get();
193	      idsToDelete.addAll(rows.map((r) => r.id));
194	    }
195	
196	    if (idsToDelete.isEmpty) return;
197	
198	    final idList = idsToDelete.toList();
199	    await batch((b) {
200	      b.deleteWhere(nostrTags, (t) => t.eventId.isIn(idList));
201	      b.deleteWhere(nostrEventRelays, (r) => r.eventId.isIn(idList));
202	      b.deleteWhere(nostrEvents, (e) => e.id.isIn(idList));
203	    });
204	  }
205	
206	  /// Filters out replaceable/parameterized-replaceable events where the DB
207	  /// already stores a version with a newer or equal `created_at`.
208	  /// Must be called inside a transaction for read consistency.
209	  Future<List<NostrEvent>> _filterStaleReplaceableEvents(
210	    Iterable<NostrEvent> events,
211	  ) async {
212	    final result = <NostrEvent>[];
213	
214	    for (final e in events) {
215	      if (e.kind >= 10000 && e.kind < 20000 || e.kind == 0 || e.kind == 3) {
216	        // Replaceable: check by kind + pubkey
217	        final existing =
218	            await (select(nostrEvents)
219	                  ..where(
220	                    (tbl) =>
221	                        tbl.kind.equals(e.kind) & tbl.pubkey.equals(e.pubkey),
222	                  )
223	                  ..orderBy([(t) => OrderingTerm.desc(t.createdAt)])
224	                  ..limit(1))
225	                .getSingleOrNull();
226	
227	        if (existing == null || e.createdAt > existing.createdAt) {
228	          result.add(e);
229	        }
230	      } else if (e.kind >= 30000 && e.kind < 40000) {
231	        final dTag = e.getDTag();
232	        if (dTag == null || dTag.isEmpty) {
233	          result.add(e);
234	        } else {
235	          // Parameterized replaceable: check by kind + pubkey + d-tag
236	          final tagSubquery = selectOnly(nostrTags)
237	            ..addColumns([nostrTags.eventId])
238	            ..where(nostrTags.tag.equals('d') & nostrTags.value.equals(dTag));
239	
240	          final existing =
241	              await (select(nostrEvents)
242	                    ..where(
243	                      (tbl) =>
244	                          tbl.kind.equals(e.kind) &
245	                          tbl.pubkey.equals(e.pubkey) &
246	                          tbl.id.isInQuery(tagSubquery),
247	                    )
248	                    ..orderBy([(t) => OrderingTerm.desc(t.createdAt)])
249	                    ..limit(1))
250	                  .getSingleOrNull();
251	
252	          if (existing == null || e.createdAt > existing.createdAt) {
253	            result.add(e);
254	          }
255	        }
256	      } else {
257	        // Regular event: always keep.
258	        result.add(e);
259	      }
260	    }
261	
262	    return _deduplicateWithinBatch(result);
263	  }

265	  List<NostrEvent> _deduplicateWithinBatch(List<NostrEvent> events) {
266	    final newest = <String, NostrEvent>{};
267	    final nonReplaceable = <NostrEvent>[];
268	
269	    for (final e in events) {
270	      if (e.kind >= 30000 && e.kind < 40000) {
271	        final dTag = e.getDTag();
272	        if (dTag != null && dTag.isNotEmpty) {
273	          final key = '${e.kind}:${e.pubkey}:$dTag';
274	          final existing = newest[key];
275	          if (existing == null || e.createdAt > existing.createdAt) {
276	            newest[key] = e;
277	          }
278	          continue;
279	        }
280	      }
281	      nonReplaceable.add(e);
282	    }
283	
284	    return [...nonReplaceable, ...newest.values];
285	  }

287	  Future<List<NostrEvent>> queryEvents(RawEventQuery query) async {
288	    if (query.tagFilters == null || query.tagFilters!.isEmpty) {
289	      final selectStmt = _buildSimpleSelect(query);
290	      final rows = await selectStmt.get();
291	      return _mapEventRowsFromEvents(rows);
292	    } else {
293	      final joined = _buildJoinedSelect(query);
294	      final rows = await joined.get();
295	      final events = _deduplicateEventRowsById(
296	        rows.map((r) => r.readTable(nostrEvents)).toList(),
297	      );
298	      return _mapEventRowsFromEvents(events);
299	    }
300	  }

302	  Stream<List<NostrEvent>> watchEvents(RawEventQuery query) {
303	    if (query.tagFilters == null || query.tagFilters!.isEmpty) {
304	      final selectStmt = _buildSimpleSelect(query);
305	      return selectStmt.watch().map(_mapEventRowsFromEvents);
306	    } else {
307	      final joined = _buildJoinedSelect(query);
308	      return joined.watch().map((rows) {
309	        final events = _deduplicateEventRowsById(
310	          rows.map((r) => r.readTable(nostrEvents)).toList(),
311	        );

317	  List<NostrEventData> _deduplicateEventRowsById(List<NostrEventData> rows) {
318	    final uniqueById = <String, NostrEventData>{};
319	    for (final row in rows) {
320	      uniqueById.putIfAbsent(row.id, () => row);
321	    }
322	    return uniqueById.values.toList(growable: false);
323	  }

325	  // Simple select on nostr_events with no tag filters
326	  SimpleSelectStatement<NostrEvents, NostrEventData> _buildSimpleSelect(
327	    RawEventQuery query,
328	  ) {
329	    final q = select(nostrEvents);
330	
331	    _applyCommonWhere(q, query);
332	
333	    q.orderBy([(e) => OrderingTerm.desc(e.createdAt)]);
334	
335	    if (query.limit != null) {
336	      q.limit(query.limit!);
337	    }
338	
339	    return q;
340	  }
